Mishneh Torah, Trespass 5:
Echad hammakdish levedek habbayit davar harauy lechazzek habbedek kegon even o kora. o hammakdish levedek habbayit davar harauy lammizbeach kegon kevasim vetorim. o hammakdish lammizbeach davar harauy levedek habbayit kegon even vekora. o hammakdish laze velaze devarim sheenan reuyin lo laze velo laze kegon hammakdish tarnegolin vechometz vetzir o karka afillu hikdish ashpa melea zevel o afar o efer. moalin bechullan mishshaa shehukdeshu ad sheyyippadu devarim haruyim lehippadot:
Kol kadshe bedek habbayit im devarim shemmoalin bahen mikkadshe mizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila veim nehena bishve peruta mikkullam maal:
Achal veheechil et chavero o nehena umehanne chavero achilato vahanayat chavero o achilat chavero vahanayato kullan mitztarfin lammeila veim naasa min hakkol hanaya bifruta maal:
Hammeila mitztarefet lizman merubbe. ketzad. nehena hayyom min hahekdesh venehena leachar kamma shanim behelem echad hare ellu mitztarfin lifruta umaal:
En meila ella betalush min hakkarka aval hannehene bakkarka atzmah o bamchubbar lah lo maal afillu pagam. ketzad. hachoresh sede hekdesh o hazzorea bah patur. natal meavakah venehena bah ufegamah maal. haddash bisde hekdesh maal sheheavak shellah moil lassade vahare nehena baavak ufagam hassade. vechen im charash sede hekdesh kede lehaalot avak leesev shennatan bah venatal haesev maal. haddar bimarat hekdesh o betzel ilan o shovach shel hekdesh af al pi shennehena lo maal. vechen hammakdish bayit banuy haddar bo lo maal. aval hammakdish etzim vaavanim uvana bahen bayit haddar sham maal kemo sheyyitbaer:
Giddule hekdesh moalin bahen. ketzad. hikdish sade vehotzia asavim ilan veasa perot moalin bahen. aval hammakdish et habbor rekan veachar kach nitmalle mayim. hikdish ashpa veachar kach nitmallet zevel. shovach venitmalle yonim. hoil veenan giddule hekdesh en moalin bahen. vechen hazzevel vehapperesh shebbachatzar hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin. uma yaasu bahen yimmachru veyippelu demehen lallishka. mayan shehu yotze mittoch sede hekdesh asur lehanot bemayim sheyyotzin mimmennu betoch hassade vehannehene lo maal. yatzu hammayim chutz lassade muttar lehanot bahen. arava haggedela bisde hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin. ilan shel hedyot hassamuch lisde hekdesh vesharashav yotzim betoch hassade. im beno leven hassade shel hekdesh ad shesh esre amma hare otan hashsharashin shebbetoch hassade asurin vehannehene mehen lo maal. haya hailan rachok yeter al shesh esre hannehene bahen maal. ilan shel hekdesh hassamuch lisde hedyot vesharashav yotzin betoch hassade im haya betoch shesh esre amma moalin bahen. haya rachok yeter al shesh esre amma otan hashsharashin shebbetoch hassede hedyot lo nehenin velo moalin:
Ken shebbarosh hailan shel hekdesh shebbana otan haof meetzim vaasavim vechayyotze bahen. kol hakken im habbetzim shebbo im haefrochim hatztzerichin leimman en nehenin bahen vehannehene lo maal:
Hammakdish et hayyaar moalin bechullo ben bailanot ben bechol ken shebberosh hailanot o shebbenehen:
Gizbarim sheshshafu atze hekdesh vekatztzu otan moalin beotan haetzim hakketannim shechatchu meet shekkatztzu. aval en moalin lo bashshippuy velo bannesoret velo banneviyya shel etzim vehu hagguf hakkashe heagol shebbetoch haetz haddome leyabbelet shello yitzlach limlacha:
Hammakdish avdo en moalin bo velo bisaro af al pi shehu omed lehiggazez mippene shehu mechubbar lo vechol zeman shehu mechubbar holech umashbiach:
Hazzorea perot hekdesh pode otan bishat ziran. veaf al pi shello pada hare haggiddulin chullin veen moalin bahen veen meshallemin mehen keren vechomesh vechayyavin bechalla:
Shemarim shel hekdesh shennatan alehem mayim. rishon vesheni ushelishi asur lehanot bo vehannehene lo maal. revii muttar. bamme devarim amurim bekadshe bedek habbayit. aval kadshe mizbeach af mervii veelach leolam asur:
Hammakdish tarnegolet lammizbeach moalin bah uvevetzatah. hikdish chamor lammizbeach moalin bah uvachalavah. hikdish torim levedek habbayit moalin bahen uvevetzatan kemo shebbearnu:
Katnot kehunna shebbalu moalin bahen kishar kadashim. vehachadashim hoil venittenu lehanot bahen en moalin bahen:
Kadshe akkum im levedek habbayit hikdishu moalin bahen. veim kadshe mizbeach hen en bahen meila min hattora shenneemar bakkarbanot <small>(Vayikra 1 2)</small> "dabber el bene yisrael". aval asur lehanot bahen middivre sofrim:
Kol umare vereach shel hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin. bamme devarim amurim kesheheriach bakketoret achar shealta hattimmoret. aval im heriach bakketoret keshettaale timratah maal:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 6:
Yesh devarim shehaadam nehene bahen velo yippagmu kegon hammishtammesh bichli zahav tahor. veyesh devarim sheyyippagmu kegon begadim uchele kesef unechoshet uvarzel vechayyotze bahen. vehannehene bishve peruta min hahekdesh sheeno mechubbar bakkarka im nehene bedavar sheen bo pegam kegon shennishtammesh bichli zahav shel hekdesh maal. nehene bedavar shennifgam kegon shellavash bigde hekdesh o baka bekordom lo maal ad sheyyifgom bahekdesh bishve peruta beoto davar atzmo shennehena bo veyitkavven lehanot veyifgom veyehane keachat. nehena bechachatzi peruta ufagam bechachatzi peruta o shennehena bishve peruta ufagam bishve peruta bedavar acher velo nehena bema sheppagam velo pagam bema shennehena hare ze lo maal ad sheyyehane bishve peruta veyifgom beotah hanaya bishve peruta baddavar atzmo. ketzad. hare shehittir matlit mibbeged hekdesh utefarah bevigdo ulevashah venehena bah bishve peruta vehifsid babbeged shehittirah mimmenna bishve peruta velo hifsid bammatlit kelum hare ze lo maal mippene shennehena bedavar echad ufagam bedavar acher. uchevar bearnu shehannehene umehanne chavero mitztaref vaafillu lizman merubbe:
Kadshe kadashim hattemimim shettalash mitztzimran. kevan shennehena bifruta maal af al pi shello pagam. shehare hen domim lechos shel zahav sheeno nifgam sheen telishat hatztzemer poselet otan millikkarev. aval im nafal bahen mum hoil velimchira omdim vehaggizza pogemet demehen lo maal ad sheyyehane veyifgom bifruta. talash mehen achar shemmetu kevan shennehena maal sheen pegam lemeta. umeila zo middivrehem kemo shebbearnu:
Hammoel bekadshe bedek habbayit kevan shemmaal bishgaga nitchallel hekdesh veze shennehena acharav patur. maal bezadon hoil veeno chayyav bekarban meila lo nitchallel hekdesh ella hare hu bahavayato veim ba acher venehena bo bishgaga maal. bamme devarim amurim keshemmaal bakkodesh vehotzio betorat chullin vehiknahu leacher. aval im nehena bo ufegamo velo hikna leacher yesh bo moel achar moel:
Veen moel achar moel bemukdashim. ella bivhema uchele tashmish bilvad. ketzad. baka bekordom shel hekdesh venehena bifruta ufagam uva chavero uvaka bo venehena ufagam kullam maalu. natal hakkordom unetano lachavero hu maal aval chavero lo maal. shata bechos shel zahav venehena bifruta uva chavero veshata venehena uva chavero veshata venehena kullam maalu. natal hakkos unetano lachavero mattana o mecharo hu maal vachavero lo maal. rachav al gabbe hachamor venehena bifruta ufagam uva chavero verachav alav venehena ufagam uva chavero verachav alav venehena ufagam. kullam maalu. natan hachamor lachavero mattana o mecharo o hiskiro hu maal vachavero lo maal. vechen hammashil kardom shel hekdesh hu maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbo vachavero muttar livkoa bo lechattechilla. vehu haddin livhema:
Behemat kadshe mizbeach enah ken ella yesh bah moel achar moel ad kamma peamim. ketzad. talash min hachattat uva chavero vetalash uva chavero vetalash kullan maalu. vechen im netanah lachavero vachavero lachavero kullan maalu. veyerae li sheddin hammenachot vehaofot vehannesachim uchele sharet kedin habbehema shekkullan kedushshat hagguf hen:
Behemat kadshe hakkadashim shennafal bah mum hoil vehi omedet lefidyon hare hu kekadshe bedek habbayit shehi kedushshat damim. veim netanah lachavero vachavero lachavero harishon bilvad maal:
Amru chachamim shehannotel even o kora shel hekdesh unetanah lachavero shenehem maalu. veim netanah leze haggizbar shehayta tachat yado hu maal vehaggizbar lo maal. veyerae li sheen ellu haddevarim amurim ella bemoel bezadon shehare lo nitchallel hekdesh. hannotel peruta shel hekdesh al daat shehi shello lo maal ad sheyyotzi otah bachafatzav o ad sheyyitten otah bemattana. netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal. sheen moel achar moel bishar hekdeshot kemo shebbearnu vechol kayyotze baze:
Natal even o kora shel hekdesh lo maal shehare lo nehena adayin. bana otah betoch beto maal. netanah al gabbe challon shebbattikra velo chibberah lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha bishve peruta sheen zo hanaya hannikkeret:
Natal peruta shel hekdesh unetanah levallan af al pi shello rachatz maal shehare nehena bihyoto rochetz bechol et sheyyirtze. vechen im netanah leechad mibbaale ummanuyyot maal af al pi sheadayin lo asu melachto:
Kana bah chefetz velo mashach im min haakkum maal. veim min yisrael lo maal:
Hammotzi meot hekdesh bitzrachav al daat shehen chullin af al pi shello hotzian bedivre chol maal. ketzad. hammevi chattato vaashamo ufischo min hahekdesh vechen mechussar kappara shehevi kapparato min hahekdesh maal. vechullam en moalin ad sheyyizzarek haddam. lefichach hammevi menachot unesachim velechem toda min hahekdesh af al pi sheavar avera lo maal sheen kan zerikat dam lechapper alav:
Natan shiklo mimmeot hekdesh kesheyyitremu hatteruma veyiknu mimmenna afillu behema achat veyizzarek damah yimol hashshokel. shehare chalku beotah habbehema shennizrak damah:
Hammafrish shiklo vehotzio bishar tzerachav. ben hu ben chavero maal. netano lachavero leshaklo al yado halach ushekalo al yede atzmo im kevar nitrema hatteruma maal hashshokel shehattorem torem al heatid lehiggavot kemo shebbearnu bishkalim ucheillu higgia shekel ze lallishka ulefichach maal. veim adayin lo nitrema teruma lo maal. uleolam en moalin bishyare hallishka:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 7:
Mi sheshshagag velakach hekdesh o meot hekdesh unetano leshaliach lehotzio betorat chullin. im asa hashshaliach shelichuto hameshalleach hu shemmaal. veim lo asa shelichuto ella asa hashshaliach middaat atzmo hashshaliach hu shemmaal. ketzad. baal habbayit sheamar lishlucho ten (li) meoto basar laorchin halach venatan lahen kikkar. o sheamar lo ten lahen kikkar venatan lahen basar. amar lishlucho have li min hachallon vehevi lo min hammigdal. o sheamar lo have min hammigdal vehevi lo min hachallon. hashshaliach maal. vechen kol kayyotze baze. halach hashshaliach vehevi min hachallon kemo sheamar lo af al pi sheamar hashsholeach lo haya belibbi sheyyavi ella min hammigdal baal habbayit maal. shehare asa shelichut maamaro udevarim shebballev enan devarim. vaafillu haya hashshaliach cheresh o shote o katan sheen lahen shelichut im asa kemaamaro baal habbayit maal veim lo asa shelichuto baal habbayit patur. amar lishlucho ten laorchin chaticha chaticha shel basar halach hashshaliach veamar lahen tolu shetayim shetayim. baal habbayit maal shehare naasa devaro vehashshaliach patur mippene shehu mosif al shelichut baal habbayit velo akar hashshelichut. aval im amar lahem hashshaliach tolu shetayim shetayim middati shenehen maalu. natlu haorchim shalosh shalosh af haorchin maalu mippene shekkol echad mehen asa shelichut chavero vehosif middato. nimtza chavero chayyav lefi shennaasu devarav velo neekra hashshelichut vehu chayyav al ze shehosif middato:
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu hachatichot mikkadshe bedek habbayit. aval im hayu besar ola vechayyotze bo lo maal ella haochel bilvad shehare hu chayyav beissur acher yeter al hammeila. uvechol hattora kullah en shaliach lidvar avera ella bimila levaddah shello yitarev immah issur acher:
Hannoten perutat hekdesh lishlucho veamar lo have li bechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot. halach vehevi lo bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot. o sheamar lo have li bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot halach vehevi bechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot shenehem peturim. baal habbayit lo maal shehare lo naasa shelichuto bifruta. vehashshaliach lo maal shehare lo akar shelichuto bifruta. aval im amar lo have li bechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvechetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni vehalach vehevi nerot mimmekom petilot ufetilot mimmekom nerot hashshaliach maal:
Natan lo shete perutot veamar lo have li etrog vehalach vehevi lo bifruta etrog uvifruta rimmon. hashshaliach maal uvaal habbayit patur shehare shelacho liknot lo etrog sheshshave shete perutot. lefichach im haya haetrog shehevi lo bifruta achat shave shete perutot shenehem maalu:
Hashsholeach peruta beyad shelucho liknot lo bah chefetz venizkar baal habbayit shehi hekdesh kodem shettaggia leyad hachenvani hashshaliach maal shehu shogeg uvaal habbayit kevar nizkar veen hammezid chayyav bekarban meila kemo shebbearnu. nizkar af hashshaliach veyada shehi hekdesh kodem shettaggia lachenvani shenehem peturim mikkarban meila vehachenvani chayyav kesheyyotzi otah peruta shennitarva bimotav shehare hu shogeg. hodiu lechenvani shepperuta shennatnu lo hekdesh shelashtan peturin venitpas hammikkach lahekdesh:
Vechetzad yaase kede lehatztzil hachenvani min hachet ad sheyyihye muttar lehishtammesh bechol hammaot. notel peruta shel chullin o keli kol shehu veomer peruta shel hekdesh bechol makom shehi mechullelet al ze. vetease otah peruta o hakkeli hekdesh veyuttar hachenvani lehishtammesh bechol hammaot. vechen peruta shel hekdesh shennitarva bechol hakkis o sheamar peruta bechis ze hekdesh. mechallel otah veachar kach yishtammesh bakkis. veim hotzi velo chillel lo maal ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis:
Amar kis mikkisay hekdesh veshor mishshevaray hekdesh. moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan. ketzad ose. mevi et haggadol shebbahem veomer im hekdesh hu hare hu hekdesh veim lav hahekdesh bechol makom shehu mechullal al ze. vihanne bakkatan:
Hammoel befachot mishsheve peruta ben bezadon ben bishgaga meshallem et hakkeren veeno chayyav chomesh velo karban. veyerae li sheeno loke al pachot mishsheve peruta im haya mezid:
Hammafkid maot etzel baal habbayit venishtammesh bahen vehotzi. baal habbayit maal. shehare en lo reshut lehishtammesh bahen uvaal happikkadon lo hirshahu:
Hifkidan etzel shulchani o chenvani velo hayu chatumin velo keshurin kesher meshunne hoil veyesh lo reshut min haddin lehishtammesh bahen im hotziu shenehen peturin. baal happikkadon patur shehare lo amar lo hishtammesh bahen. vehachenvani patur mippene sheenan keshurin kesher meshunne velo chatumin ucheillu hishtammesh birshut:
Haishsha shehichnisa maot shel hekdesh levalah. o shehikdish morishah umet venaflu lah hekdeshot birushsha. lichsheyyotzi habbaal hammaot bachafatzav yimol:
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 8:
Happoalim shehen osin behekdesh af al pi sheppasku immahen mezonot lo yochlu miggerogarot shel hekdesh veim achlu maalu. ella hahekdesh noten lahem deme mezonot:
Haddash karshine hekdesh hare ze chosem et happara. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 4)</small> "lo tachsom shor bedisho" dayish harauy lo:
En mechallelin et hahekdesh al hammelacha ella al hammaot. ketzad. umman sheasa melacha behekdesh bemane en notnin lo behemat hekdesh o tallit hekdesh bischaro ad shemmechallelin otan al hammaot. veachar sheyyeasu chullin notnin otan laumman bischaro im ratzu. vechozrin velokchin mimmennu behema mitterumat hallishka:
Keshebbonin bammikdash en lokchin etzim vaavanim min hahekdesh velo bonin et habbinyan al daat shehu kodesh ella bonin hakkol min hachol. gezera shemma yehane betzel habbinyan o yishshaen al even o kora bishat melacha. veachar sheyyushlam habbinyan mechallelin meot hahekdesh al habbinyan. veim tzarchu haggizbarin leetzim lakkodesh leoto hayyom bilvad lokchin otan mimmeot hahekdesh shehare enan mitacharin yamim kede shennachush lahen shemma yishshaen adam alehen veyimol:
Keshepposkin im haummanin livnot bammikdash uvaazarot. poskin immahen kach vechach amma bechach vechach sela beamma bat esrim etzba. ucheshemmoshchin lahen ma shebbanu moshchin umechashshevin lahen beamma gedola bat esrim vearba etzbaot kede shello yavou lide meila mippene sheen medakdekin bimshicha:
Tenay bet din sheyyihyu hakkohanim neotin bammelach uvaetzim baachilat karbanot sheochlin bechelkan. aval lo yittenu melach hammikdash bechullin shellahen:
Melach sheal gabbe haevar moalin bo. sheal gabbe hakkevesh vesheal rosh hammizbeach en moalin bo:
Rauy laadam lehitbonen bemishpete hattora hakkedosha veleda sof inyanam kefi kocho. vedavar shello yimtza lo taam velo yeda lo illa al yehi kal beenav velo yaharos laalot el Adonai pen yifrotz bo. velo tehe machashavto bo kemachshavto bishar divre hachol. bo uree kamma hechmira tora bimila. uma im etzim vaavanim veafar vaefer kevan shennikra shem adon haolam alehem bidvarim bilvad nitkaddeshu vechol hannoheg bahen minhag chol maal bah vaafillu haya shogeg tzarich kappara. kal vachomer lemitzvot shechakak lanu hakkadosh baruch hu shello yivat haadam bahen mippene shello yeda taman. velo yechappe devarim asher lo ken al hashshem velo yachshov bahen machshavto kedivre hachol. hare neemar battora <small>(Vayikra 19 37)</small> <small>(Vayikra 20 22)</small> "ushemartem et kol chukkotay veet kol mishpatay vaasitem otam". amru chachamim litten shemira vaasiyya lachukkim kammishpatim. vehaasiyya yedua vehi sheyyaase hachukkim. vehashshemira sheyyizzaher bahen velo yedamme shehen pechutin min hammishpatim. vehammishpatim hen hammitzvot shettaman galuy vetovat asiyyatan baolam hazze yedua kegon issur gezel ushefichut damim vechibbud av vaem. vehachukkim hen hammitzvot sheen taman yadua. amru chachamim chukkim chakkoti lecha veen lecha reshut lehareher bahen. veyitzro shel adam nokfo bahen veummot haolam meshivin alehen kegon issur besar chazir uvasar bechalav veegla arufa ufara adumma vesair hammishtalleach. vechamma haya david hammelech mitztaer min hamminim umin haakkum shehayu meshivin al hachukkim. vechol zeman shehayu rodfin oto bitshuvot hashsheker sheorchin lefi kotzer daat haadam haya mosif devekut battora. shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 119 69)</small> "taflu alay sheker zedim ani bechol lev etztzor pikkudecha". veneemar sham bainyan <small>(Tehillim 119 86)</small> "kol mitzvotecha emuna sheker redafuni azreni". vechol hakkarbanot kullan mikkelal hachukkim hen. amru chachamim shebbishvil avodat hakkarbanot haolam omed. shebbaasiyyat hachukkim vehammishpatim zochin hayesharim lechayye haolam habba. vehikdima tora tziuuy al hachukkim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 5)</small> "ushemartem et chukkotay veet mishpatay asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem".
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 1:
Mitzvat ase lishchot et happesach bearbaa asar lechodesh nisan achar chatzot. veen shochatin ella min hakkevasim o min haizzim bilvad zachar ben shana. veechad haish veechad haishsha chayyavin bemitzva zo:
Vmi shebbittel mitzva zo bezadon veavar yom arbaa asar velo hikriv vehu lo tame velo badderech rechoka hare ze chayyav karet. veim bittelah bishgaga patur:
En shochatin et happesach ella baazara kishar hakkadashim. af bishat hetter habbamot lo hayu makrivin et happesach bevamat yachid [2.] vechol hammakriv et happesach bevamat yachid loke [3.] shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 5)</small> "lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad shearecha". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lashshochet bevamat yachid afillu bishat hetter habbamot:
Shechitat happesach achar chatzot. veim shechato kodem chatzot pasul. veen shochatin oto ella achar tamid shel ben haarbayim. achar shemmaktirin ketoret shel ben haarbayim veachar shemmetivin et hannerot matchilin lishchot et happesachim ad sof hayyom. veim shechato achar chatzot kodem tamid shel ben haarbayim kasher veyihye echad memares bedam happesach ad sheyyizzarek dam hattamid veachar kach yizrok dam happesach acharav. veim nizrak dam happesach kodem dam hattamid kasher:
Hashshochet et happesach bizmanno vehaya lo kezayit chametz birshuto loke. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 18)</small> "lo tizbach al chametz dam zivchi". shello yizbach happesach vehechametz kayyam. echad hashshochet veechad hazzorek et haddam veechad hammaktir et haemurin im haya birshut echad mehem o birshut echad mibbene chavura sheochlin pesach ze kezayit chametz bishat hakeravato hare ze loke vehappesach kasher: 
Dam happesach taun sheficha keneged hayesod. veachar sheshshofchim damo mafshitim oto vekorin et bitno umotziin et emurav umaktirin otan chalavin kol zevach vezevach levaddo. uvaal hazzevach notel pischo im haor shello umevi leveto lirushalayim vetzolehu veochel laerev:
Hammanniach emurim velo hiktiran ad shellanu venifselu belina hare ze over belo taase. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 18)</small> "lo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker". veaf al pi sheavar eno loke lefi sheen bo maase:
Umaktirin chelve pesachim kol hallayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. bamme devarim amurim keshechal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat shehare chelve shabbat kerevin beyom tov. aval im chal arbaa asar lihyot bechol en maktirin chelve chol beyom tov:
Happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 6)</small> "veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael". kahal. veeda. veyisrael. veen pochatin mishsheloshim bene adam bechol kat vechat:
Hayu hakkol chamishshim. nichnasim battechilla sheloshim veshochatin. veyotzim asara venichnasin asara. vechozrin veyotzin asara venichnasin asara:
Hayu pachot mechamishshim en shochatin et happesach lechattechilla [veim shachatu kasher]. veim shachatu kullan bevat achat kasher. ketzad nishchat. nichnesa hakkat harishona ad shettitmalle haazara venoalin daltot haazara umatchilin lishchot et pischehen. vechol zeman shehen shochatin umakrivin korim halleviyyim et hahallel. im gamru hahallel vaadayin lo shalma hakkat millehakriv shonim. veim shanu velo shalmu lehakeriv meshalleshin. umeolam lo shilleshu:
Al kol keria ukeria tokin shalosh tekiot bachatzotzrot. tekia terua utekia. hoil veen lo nesachim litkoa bishat nissuch tokin bishat shechita:
Hakkohanim omdim shurot shurot uvidehen mizreke kesef umizreke zahav. shura shekkullah kesef kesef. shura shekkullah zahav zahav. velo hayu meoravim kede sheyyihye lahem noy. velo hayu lammizrakin shulayim kede shello yannichum veyikrash haddam:
Shachat hashshochet vekibbel hakkohen. notno lachavero vachavero lachavero kede sheyyitasseku rabbim bammitzva ad sheyyaggia haddam etzel kohen hakkarov lammizbeach. shofcho sheficha achat keneged hayesod umekabbel mizrak echad male veachar kach machzir et harekan. vetolin umafshitin et kullo vekoro umemache et keravav ad shemmesir mehen hatztzoa vehapperesh. umotzi et haemurin venotnan bichli umolchan umaktiran hakkohen al gabbe hammizbeach. vechetzad tolin umafshitin. masmerot shel barzel hayu kevuin bakketalim uvaammudim shebbahen tolin umafshitin. vechol mi shello matza makom litlot maklot dakkim vachalakim hayu sham manniach al ketefo veal ketef chavero vetole umafshit:
Shalmu millehakriv potchin daltot haazara veyotzet kat harishona venichnesa sheniyya. yatzat sheniyya venichnesa shelishit. kemaase rishona kach maase sheniyya ushelishit. shalma kat shelishit veyatzat rochatzim et haazara:
Chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat kemaasehu bechol kach maasehu beshabbat. verochatzin et haazara beshabbat sheen issur shevut bammikdash afillu bedavar sheeno tzorech avoda issur shevut bammikdash hetter hu:
En kol echad veechad molich et pischo leveto beshabbat. ella kat harishona yotzin befischehem veyoshvin behar habbayit. vehashsheniyya yotzin befischehen veyoshvin bachel. vehashshelishit omdin bimkoman baazara. veshohim hakkol ad motzae shabbat veholech kol echad befischo leveto:
Shechitat happesach uzerikat damo umichuy keravav vehekter chalavav dochin et hashshabbat. shei efshar laasotan kodem hashshabbat shehare kavua lo zeman shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 2 3)</small> "bemoado". aval harekavato vahavaato michutz lattechum vachatichat yabbalato bichli enan dochin et hashshabbat shehare efshar laasotan kodem hashshabbat. veim yachol lachtoch yabbalto beyado beshabbat chotech. veim hayta yevesha chotchah afillu bichli sheen shevut bammikdash kelal. vechen tzeliyyato vahadachat keravav enan dochin et hashshabbat shehare efshar laasotan leachar hashshabbat:
Shachach velo hevi sakkin lo yevienna beshabbat. ella notnah ben karne hakkeves o betzamro umakkisho ad shemmevio laazara umakdisho sham. veaf al pi shehu mechammer beshabbat mechammer kilachar yad hu umippene hammitzva muttar. bamme devarim amurim keshello hikdish pischo adayin velo amar ze pesach aval im hikdisho lo yavi sakkin alav mippene shehu oved bekadashim. umippene ma hittiru lehakedish pischo beshabbat hoil vekavua lo zeman muttar lehakedisho beshabbat. vechen makdish adam chagigato beyom tov veeno choshesh:
Hashshochet et happesach venimtza baal mum o terefa hare ze shochet acher ben bechol ben beshabbat afillu mea ze achar ze shochet veholech ad sheyyichshar echad o ad shettecheshach veyiddache lashsheni shehare anus hu:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 2:
En shochatin et happesach ella limnuyav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 4)</small> "tachossu al hasse" melammed shemmitmannim alav keshehu chay. veellu hammitmannim al happesach hem hannikraim bene chavura:
Yachid sheshshachat et happesach leatzmo kasher. vehu sheyyihye rauy leechol et kullo. umishtaddelin shello yishchat lechattechilla al yachid shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 47)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 9 11 12)</small> "yaasu oto": 
En shochatin et happesach ella al mi sherauy leechol. haya echad mibbene chavura katan o zaken o chole im yachol leechol kezayit shochatin alav veim lav en shochatin alav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 4)</small> "ish lefi achlo" ad sheyyihye rauy leechol. afillu chavura shel mea veen kol echad mehen yachol leechol kezayit en shochatin alehen:
En osin chavura nashim vaavadim o ketannim vaavadim mippene shello tihye kallut rosh benehen. aval osim chavura kullam nashim afillu befesach sheni. o kullah avadim. veshochatin al hakketannim sheyyihyu mikkelal bene hachavura. lo shettihye chavura kullah ketannim sheenan bene daat. vechen en osin chavura kullah cholim o zekenim o onnim af al pi shehen yecholin leechol hoil vaachilatam meuta. shemma yashiru happesach viviuhu lide pesul. veim avru veshachatu al chavura zo kasher. vechen en osin chavura kullah gerim shemma yedakdeku bo viviuhu lide pissul. veim shachatu alehen kasher:
Shechato shello limnuyav o lemi sheen kol echad mehen yachol leechol kezayit o sheshshechato laarelim o litmeim pasul. shechato lemi sheyyachol leechol ulemi sheeno yachol leechol kezayit. limnuyav veshello limnuyav. lemulim velaarelim. lithorim velitmein. kasher. sheellu haruyin lo ochlin kahalacha vehaacherim keillu lo chashav alehem:
Shechato lemulim vezarak haddam leshem mulim vaarelim pasul. shehazzerika chamura shehi ikkar hakkarban. shechato lemulim sheyyitkapperu bo arelim pasul shehare yesh machashevet arelim bizrika. shechato leochlav lizrok damo shello leochlav happesach kasher veen adam yotze bo yede chovato lefi sheen machashevet ochlim bazzerika:
Mi shehu bari bishat shechita vechole bishat zerika. o chole bishat shechita uvari bishat zerika. en shochatin vezorkin alav ad sheyyihye bari mishsheat shechita ad sheat zerika:
Shochet adam al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim ben middatan ben shello middatan. aval eno shochet al yede beno uvitto haggedolim velo al yede avdo veshifchato haivrim velo al yede ishto ella middatan. veim shatku velo michu hare ze middatan:
Shachat al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim vehalchu veshachatu hen leatzman yotzin beshel rabban:
Shachat al yede ishto uveno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veshachatu hen leatzman. en lecha michuy gadol mizze veenan yotzin ella beshel atzman:
Haishsha shehi bevet balah shachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah tochal mishshel balah. hayta nechpezet lalechet levet aviha baregel harishon hassamuch lenissueha kederech kol habbanot veshachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah tochal mishshel aviha. mikkan veelach tochal mimmakom shehi rotza. vehu shettivror lah makom shettirtze bishat shechita. vechen yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin yochal mimmakom shehu rotze. bamme devarim amurim beyatom katan. aval gadol naase kimmanne atzmo al shene pesachim vehamemanne atzmo al shene pesachim eno ochel ella min hannishchat rishon:
Eved shel shene shuttafin bizman shemmakpidin ze al ze shello yignevennu lo yochal mishshel shenehen. veim enan makpidin mimmakom sheyyirtze yochal:
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. lo yochal lo mishshel rabbo velo mishshel atzmo ad sheyyease kullo ben chorin:
Ad kamma nimnim al happesach. ad sheyyihye bo kezayit lechol echad veechad. venimnin alav umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet. kevan shennishchat eno yachol limshoch et yado shehare nishchat alav. nimnu alav vechazru acherim venimnu alav. rishonim sheyyesh lahem kezayit ochlim ufeturim measot pesach sheni veacharonim sheravu ad shello nimtza bo kezayit lechol echad enan ochlin vechayyavim laasot pesach sheni:
Hamemanne acherim immo al chelko velo yadu bahen bene hachavura hare bene hachavura rashshain litten lo chelko achar sheyyitztzale beet haachila uvene hachavura ochlin mishshellahen vehu ochel chelko im haacherim shemmana alav bachavura sheniyya. vechen bene hachavura shehaya echad mehem gargeran rashshaim lehotzio mehen venotnin lo chelko veyochlehu bachavurato. veim eno zolel enan rashshain lechallek:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 3:
Haomer leavdo tze ushechot alay et happesach. af al pi shedderech rabbo lishchot tale bechol shana vehalach veshachat alav gedi o shehaya darko lishchot gedi vehalach veshachat alav tale hare ze yochal mimmennu. shehare lo peresh veamar lo shechot li mimmin peloni. halach veshachat gedi vetale eno ochel mishshenehen ella yetzu levet hasserefa sheen nimnin al shene pesachim. veim haya melech o malka veamar leavdo lishchot alav veshachat gedi vetale yochal min harishon mishshum shelom malchut:
Haomer lishlucho tze ushechot alay et happesach vekava lo gedi o tale veshachach ma amar lo rabbo. hare ze shochet gedi vetale veomer im gedi amar li gedi shello vetale shelli veim tale amar li tale shello ugedi shelli. shachach hashsholeach ma amar lo shenehen yetzu levet hasserefa. veim shachach hashsholeach kodem sheyyizzarek haddam chayyavin laasot pesach sheni. shachach achar shennizrak haddam patur millaasot pesach sheni. vechen haddin beomer leavdo tze ushechot alay vekava lo veshachach haeved ma amar lo rabbo. vehu sheyyitten lo roe shel rabbo gedi vetale veyomar lo shechot shenehen kede shettishchot kemo sheamar lo rabbecha vahare echad mehen shellecha al menat shello yihye lerabbecha bo kelum. im asa haroe kach achar kach yihye efshar laeved lehatenot kemo shebbearnu:
Bene chavura sheamru laechad tze ushechot lanu et happesach veamar hu lahen veattem shachatu alay veshachatu hem veshachat hu kullam ochlin mizze shennishchat rishon vehaacharon yetze levet hasserefa:
Chavura sheavad pischah veamru laechad tze uvakkesh ushechot alenu. halach umatza pesach sheavad ushechato vehem lakchu pesach acher ushechatuhu im shello nishchat rishon hu ochel mishshello vehen ochlin immo vehashsheni yissaref veim shellahen nishchat rishon hen ochlin mishshellahen vehu ochel mishshello. en yadua e ze mehen nishchat rishon o sheshshachatu shenehen keachat hu ochel mishshello vehen enan ochlin immo veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni:
Amar lahem ze sheshshelachuhu levakkesh pesach sheavad uleshochoto im echarti shachatu attem alay. halach umatza veshachat vehem lakchu veshachatu. im shellahen nishchat rishon hem ochlin mishshellahem vehu ochel immahem vehashsheni yissaref. veim shello nishchat rishon hu ochel mishshello vehen ochlin mishshellahen. en yadua e ze mehen nishchat rishon o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad hen ochlin mishshellahen vehu eno ochel immahen. veshello yetze levet hasserefa ufatur millaasot pesach sheni:
Avad lahen pischam veavad lo pischo veamar lahen tzeu uvakkeshu veshachatu alay veamru lo tze uvakkesh ushechot alenu vehalach umatza veshachat umatzu hem veshachatu. kullam ochlin min harishon vehashsheni yissaref. veim en yadua e ze nishchat techilla o sheshshachatu shenehen keechad shenehen yissarfu ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni. halach hu levakkesh vehalchu hem levakkesh velo amru ze laze kelum. af al pi shehaya belibbam sheyyishchot kol echad mehen al chavero. o shehayu sham remizot udevarim sheumdan haddaat bahen shekkol echad sheyyimtza yishchot al chavero. hoil velo pershu velo amru ze laze kelum enan achrain ze laze:
Shete chavurot shennitarvu pischehen kodem sheyyishshachatu. chavura zo lokchin keves echad min hattaarovot. vehashsheniyya lokchin hashsheni. veechad mibbene chavura zo ba etzel ellu. veechad mibbene sheniyya ba etzel harishona. vechol chavura mehen omrot leze haechad shebba etzlam im shellanu hu happesach hazze yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shellanu veim shellecha hu happesach hazze yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu venimnenu al shellecha. vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha bene adam o eser chavurot shel asara asara moshchin lahen echad mikkol chavura lachavura haacheret vechach hem matnim veomrim veachar kach shochatin:
Shenayim shennitarvu pischehen ze lokeach pesach echad min hattaarovot veze lokeach lo echad. veze memanne al pischo echad min hashshuk vehaacher memanne immo echad min hashshuk kede sheyyihyu shete chavurot. veachar kach yavo echad mishshenehem etzel ellu veyavo echad meellu etzel haacher umatne kol echad im chavero shebba etzlo mechavura sheniyya veomer im shelli hu pesach ze yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shelli veim shellecha hu yadi meshucha mippesach shelli venimneti al shellecha venimtza shello hifsidu kelum:
Chamishsha shennitarvu orot pischehen nimtzet yabbelet beor echad mehen kullam yetzu levet hasserefa. veim nitarvu kodem zerikat daman chayyavin befesach sheni. nitarvu char zerika peturin millaasot pesach sheni sheim hikrivu pesach sheni nimtza ze shekkarav barishon karban kasher mevi chullin azara. veim nimnu kullan al pesach echad nimtza nishchat shello limchuyyav veze kemi shennishchat shello limnuyav. veim hitna kol chad mehen veamar im eno pesach yihye shelamim dam happesach bishficha vedam hashshelamim bizrika vehannittanin bizrika al yittenem bishficha lechattechilla lefichach peturin mippesach sheni:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 4:
Kevar nitbaer behilchot pesule hammukdashin shehappesach eno nishchat ella leshem pesach uleshem bealav veim shechato bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem pasul. hashshochet et happesach al bene chavura veamar lahem leachar zeman oto happesach sheshshachatti alechem shello lishmo shechattiv. im haya neeman lahen somchin al devarav. veim lav shurat haddin sheeno neeman. veharotze lehachemir al atzmo hare ze meshubbach veyavi pesach sheni:
Besar happesach shennitma venoda lo kodem zerika af al pi shehaemurin tehorin lo yizrok et haddam sheen happesach ba ella laachila veim zarak lo hurtztza. veim lo noda lo ad shennizrak haddam hurtztza shehatztzitz meratztze al shiggat habbasar shennitma veeno meratztze al hazzadon. nitmeu miktzat haevarim soref et hattemeim veochel et hattehorim. nitmeu haemurim vehabbasar kayyam zorek et haddam vehabbasar neechol laerev. nitmeu habbealim achar shennishchat lo yizrok et haddam veim zarak lo hurtztza. lefichach chayyavin befesach sheni sheen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf ella im nitmea betumat hattehom kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat hammikdash:
Happesach sheyyatza mirushalayim o shennitma bearbaa asar yissaref miyyad. nitmeu habbealim o metu o mashchu et yedehem afillu nitmeu o metu kodem zerikat haddam mannichin oto ad shetteubbar tzurato veachar kach yissaref. ze hakkelal kol sheppesulo begufo yissaref miyyad. baddam o babbealim teubbar tzurato veachar kach yissaref. lefichach im shechato achar shennoda shemmashchu habbealim et yedehem o metu o nitmeu veniddechu lefesach sheni hare ze yissaref miyyad. bamme devarim amurim sheyyissaref im nitmeu habbealim keshennitmeu kol bene hachavura. aval im nitmeu miktzatan zachu tehorim bechelkam shel temeim. af al pi shennitmeu miktzatan achar shehitchilu leechol zachu hattehorim sheadayin lo hitchilu. aval im hitchilu kullan venitmeu miktzatan lo zachu tehorim bechelkan shel temeim ella hattehorim ochlin chelkam vechelek hattemeim yissaref. vehu haddin im metu miktzatan. nitma shalem o rubbo sorfim oto lifne habbira bifne hakkol kede levayyeshan ad sheyyizaharu bo. vesorfin oto meatze hammaaracha kede shello yachshedu otan veyomru meatze hammaaracha ganvu. lefichach im yisrefuhu bekash uvekanim veratzu lisrof mishshel atzman sorfin. nitma miuto vechen hannotar sorfin oto bechatzrotehen meatze atzman aval lo meatze hammaaracha shello yishshaaru mehen etzlam veyimalu bahen:
Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o zachar ben shete shanim. yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyimmacher veyavi bedamav pesach. veim lo nafal bah mum ad shehikriv pischo yavi bedamav shelamim:
Hifrish pischo umet. lo yeviennu beno acharav leshem happesach ella leshem shelamim. veim haya memunne im aviv alav yeviennu leshem pesach. bamme devarim amurim keshemmet aviv achar chatzot arbaa asar aval kodem chatzot hare ze nidche lefesach sheni mippene shehu onen kemo sheyyitbaer veyavi pischo ze bashsheni:
Mi sheavad pischo umetzao achar shehifrish pesach acher vahare shenehen omdin yakriv e ze mehen sheyyirtze leshem pesach vehashsheni yikrav shelamim. metzao achar sheshshachat pischo hare ze yikrav shelamim. vechen im hemir baze hannimtza achar shechita hare temura zo tikrav shelamim. aval im metzao kodem shechitat ze shehifrish. hoil veze hannimtza rauy lehakerivo pesach verauy lehakerivo shelamim kemo shebbearnu. im hemir baze hannimtza ben kodem shechitat hammufrash tachtav ben achar shechita. en temurato kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyavi bedameha shelamim:
Pesach sheavra shenato ushelamim habbaim mechamat happesach hare hem kishlamim lechol davar teunin semicha unesachim utenufat chaze veshok ma sheen ken befesach:
Pesach shennitarev bishlamim yikrevu kullan shelamim. nitarev bizvachim acherim yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze uvidme hayyafe shebbahen shelamim veyafsid hammotar mibbeto kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin. nitarev bivchorot. yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyeachelu kivchor baal mum. veyavi behema shehi yafa kayyafa shebbetaarovot veyomar kol makom shehu happesach kedushshato tachul al zo veyakrivenna shelamim im karev pischo:
Hammafrish pischo ad shello nitgayyer venitgayyer. ad shello nishtachrer venishtachrer. ad shello hevi shete searot vehevi. hare ze makrivo leshem pesach. sheen baale chayyim nidchin kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin:
Hammafrish maot lefischo vehotiru. yavi hammotar shelamim. hamemanne acherim al pischo veal chagigato. hare hammaot sheyyikkach mehen bechelkam chullin. af al pi shezze hifrish tale lefischo veze hifrish maot lefischo velakach mimmennu hammaot uminnahu al pischo hare hammaot chullin sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael et pischehen veet chagigatan veet meot pischehen vachagigatan:
Etzim shel tzeliyyat happesach kefesach. vechen matztza umaror hoil vehen machshire happesach hare hem kefesach. veim lakach mimmeot happesach mimmi shemminna otan immo kede lemannotan immo bammatztza umaror o lihyot lo chelek baetzim shetztzole bahen hare hammaot chullin:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 5:
Mi shehaya tame bishat shechitat happesach sheen shochatin alav. o shehaya bederech rechoka. o neenas beones acher. o sheshshagag velo hikriv barishon. hare ze mevi pesach bearbaa asar lachodesh hashsheni ben haarbayim. ushechitat pesach ze mitzvat ase bifne atzmo vedocha et hashshabbat sheen hashsheni tashlumin larishon ella regel bifne atzmo lefichach chayyavin alav karet:
Ketzad. mi sheshshagag o neenas velo hikriv barishon im hezid velo hikriv bashsheni chayyav karet. veim shagag o neenas af bashsheni patur. hezid velo hikriv barishon hare ze makriv bashsheni. veim lo hikriv bashsheni af al pi sheshshagag hare ze chayyav karet shehare lo hikriv karban Adonai bemoado vehaya mezid. aval mi shehaya tame o bederech rechoka velo asa et harishon. af al pi shehezid bashsheni eno chayyav karet. shekkevar niftar befesach rishon min hakkaret:
Umi shehaya bederech rechoka veshachatu vezarku alav et haddam. af al pi shebba laerev lo hurtztza vechayyav befesach sheni:
Tame sheyyachol littaher befesach rishon. shello taval ella yashav betumato ad sheavar zeman hakkarban. vechen arel shello mal ad sheavar zeman hakkarban. hare ze mezid barishon. lefichach im lo asa et hashsheni afillu bishgaga chayyav karet:
Keshem shemmilat atzmo meakkavto millaasot pesach kach milat banav hakketannim umilat kol avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim meakkevet oto. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 48)</small> "himmol lo chol zachar veaz yikrav laasoto". veim shachat kodem sheyyamul otam happesach pasul. vechen tevilat amhotav leshem avdut meakkavto. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala. shehattevila lishfachot kemila laavadim:
Hakkatan en milat avadav utevilat shifchotav meakkavto millehimmanot al happesach. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 44)</small> "vechol eved ish" lehotzi et hakkatan:
Ger shennitgayyer ben pesach rishon lefesach sheni. vechen katan shehigdil ben shene pesachim. chayyavin laasot pesach sheni. veim shachatu alav barishon patur:
Nashim shenniddechu lashsheni. ben mippene haones vehashshegaga. ben mippene hattuma vederech rechoka. hare pesach sheni lahem reshut. ratzu shochatin ratzu en shochatin. lefichach en shochatin alehen bifne atzman beshabbat befesach sheni. aval im hayta haishsha achat mibbene chavura muttar. vee zo hi derech rechoka. chamishsha asar mil chutz lechomat yerushalayim:
Mi shehaya beno uven yerushalayim yom arbaa asar im aliyyat hashshamesh chamishsha asar mil o yeter hare ze derech rechoka. haya beno uvenah pachot mizze eno bederech rechoka mippene shehu yachol lehaggia lirushalayim achar chatzot kesheyyehallech beraglav benachat. halach velo higgia mippene sheikkevuhu habbehemot bedochokam. o shehaya birushalayim vehaya chole beraglav velo higgia laazara ad sheavar zeman hakkarban. hare ze anus veeno bederech rechoka. mi shehaya chavush chutz lechomat yerushalayim vehivtichuhu latzet laerev. shochatin alav uchesheyyetze laerev yochal. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya chavush beyad yisrael. aval im haya chavush beyad akkum en shochatin alav ad sheyyetze. veim shachatu alav veyatza hare ze ochel. veim lo yatza patur millaasot pesach sheni shehare nishchat alav. vechen haonen vehachole vehazzaken shehem yecholin leechol sheshshachatu alehen veachar shennizrak haddam nitmeu bemet vahare enan yecholin leechol. hare ellu peturin millaasot pesach sheni:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 6:
E zehu tame shennidche lefesach sheni. kol mi sheeno yachol leechol et happesach belele 15 benisan mippene tumato kegon zavim vezavot niddot veyoldot uvoale niddot. aval hannogea binvela vesheretz vechayyotze bahen beyom arbaa asar hare ze tovel veshochatin alav achar sheyyitbol. velaerev kesheyyaariv shimsho ochel et happesach:
Teme met shechal shevii shello lihyot bearbaa asar af al pi shettaval vehuzza alav vahare hu rauy leechol kadashim laerev. en shochatin alav ella nidche lefesach sheni. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 6)</small> "vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheshshevii shellahen haya veal ze shaalu im yishshachet alehen vehem yochlu laerev uferesh lahen sheen shochatin alehen. bamme devarim amurim beshennitma betumot min hammet shehannazir megalleach alehen aval im haya tame bishar tumot min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach alehen. shochatin alav bashshevii shello achar sheyyitbol veyazze alav uchesheyyaariv shimsho ochel pischo:
Zav sheraa shete reiyyot vesafar shiva yamim vetaval bashshevii shochatin alav vehu ochel laerev. veim raa zov achar shennizrak haddam hare ze patur millaasot pesach sheni. vechen shomeret yom keneged yom tovelet beyom hashshimmur kemo shebbearnu beviot asurot. veshochatin aleha vehi ochelet laerev. veim raata dam achar shennizrak dam happesach petura millaasot pesach sheni. veen shochatin al hannidda bashshevii shellah. shehare enah tovelet ad lel shemini veenah reuya leechol kadashim ad lel teshii:
Mechussere kippurim shechal yom havaat karbenotehen bearbaa asar. shochatin alehen umakrivin karbenotehen bearbaa asar benisan ben kodem shechitat happesach ben achar shechitato. veochlin pischehen laerev. veen shochatin alehen ad sheyyimseru karbenotehen beyad bet din shemma yifsheu velo yakrivu otam:
Metzora shechal shemini shello lihyot bearbaa asar veraa keri bo bayyom hare ze tovel venichnas leezrat nashim umevi karbenotav. veaf al pi shettevul yom asur lehikkanes leezrat nashim. hoil veissuro lehikkanes sham middivrehem kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat mikdash. veyom ze hu yom hakeravat happesach bemoado. yavo ase sheyyesh bo karet veyidche issur shel divrehem:
Teme met shechal shevii shello lihyot beshabbat. en mazzin alav ella lemachar. vaafillu chal shevii shello lihyot bishlosha asar benisan vehu shabbat yiddache leyom arbaa asar. umazzin alav veen shochatin alav kemo shebbearnu. ella yiddache lefesach sheni. vahalo issur hazzaya beshabbat mishshum shevut vehappesach becharet veheach yaamidu divrehem bimkom karet. mippene shebbeyom shehu asur behazzaya mishshum shevut eno zeman hakkarban shechayyavin alav karet. lefichach heemidu divrehen bimkoman af al pi shehaddavar gorem leatid lavo laamod bimkom karet:
Yisrael arel shemmal beerev happesach shochatin alav achar shemmal. aval ger shennitgayyer beyom arbaa asar umal vetaval en shochatin alav sheeno ochel laerev vahare hu keforesh min hakkever shetztzarich shiva yamim veachar kach yithar. gezera shemma yittame ger ze lemet leshana habbaa beyom arbaa asar veyitbol veyochal laerev veyomar eshtakad kach asu li yisrael keshemmalti tavalti veachalti laerev. vahalo gezera zo middivrehem ufesach becharet veheach heemidu divrehem bimkom karet beyom hakkarban shehu yom arbaa asar. mippene sheen hagger mitchayyev bemitzvot ad sheyyamul veyitbol. veeno tovel ad sheyyerafe min hammila kemo shebbearnu beinyan haggerut. lefichach heemidu divrehem bemakom ze. shehare ze hammal yesh lo shello litbol ad sheyyavri velo yavo lide chiyyuv kelal:
Mi shebba bevet happeras hare ze menappeach veholech veim lo matza etzem velo nitma shochet veochel pischo veaf al pi shehalach bevet happeras. shettumat bet happeras middivrehen kemo shebbearnu behilchot teme met velo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet kemo shebbearnu. vechen bet happeras shenniddosh tahor laose pesach:
Haonen rauy leechol happesach laerev. mippene sheaninut layla middivrehem lo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet bedavar ze ella shochatin alav vetovel veachar kach ochel kede sheyyifrosh meaninuto velo yassiach dato. bamme devarim amurim shemmet lo hammet achar chatzot shekkevar nitchayyev bekarban pesach. aval im met lo hammet kodem chatzot en shochatin alav ella yiddache lashsheni. veim shachatu alav vezarku haddam tovel veochel laerev. met lo met bishlosha asar ukevaro bearbaa asar hare hu beyom kevura onen middivrehem veeno tofes lelo middivrehem. lefichach shochatin alav vetovel veochel laerev af bishar hakodashim. veyom shemua veyom likkut atzamot hare hu keyom kevura. lefichach mi shellikket atzmot meto beyom arbaa asar o sheshshama shemmet lo met shochatin alav vetovel veochel bekadashim laerev:
Mi shechofer begal levakkesh al hammet en shochatin alav shemma yimmatze sham hammet baggal vahare hu tame bishat shechita. shachatu alav velo nimtza sham met hare ze ochel laerev. nimtza sham met achar shennizrak haddam. im noda lo bevadday shehaya tame bishat zerikat haddam kegon shehaya gal agol hare ze chayyav befesach sheni. veim safek haddavar veshemma lo haya omed al hattuma beet zerika velo nitma ella achar zerika hare ze patur mippesach sheni:
Mi sheavar badderech umatza met mushkav lerachbah shel derech. im haya hammet tumat hattehom af al pi shehu tame litruma hare ze tahor lefesach veshochet veochel pischo veaf al pi sheefshar shennaga. hoil vehi tumat hattehom tahor lefesach. veaf al pi shehammet shalem vehu min hakkatze el hakkatze hare ze ose pischo ad sheyyeda bevadday shennitma bo. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya mehallech beraglav shehare efshar shello yigga aval im haya rochev o taun massa hare ze tame af al pi shehi tumat hattehom. lefi shei efshar shello yigga veshello yasit veshello yaahil. uchevar bearnu tumat hattehom behilchot nezirut:
Mi sheasa pesach bechezkat shehu tahor veachar kach noda lo shehaya tame betumat hattehom eno chayyav befesach sheni. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala. aval im noda lo shehaya tame betuma yedua chayyav befesach sheni:
Mi shennitma bemet vehuzza alav shelishi ushevii uvashshevii shello nitma bekever hattehom velo yada veasa pesach bechezkat shehu tahor veachar kach noda lo shehu tame betumat hattehom eno chayyav befesach sheni. shekkevan shettaval bashshevii paska tuma harishona. aval im nitma betumat hattehom bashshishshi letumato velo yada ad sheasa happesach. hare ze chayyav befesach sheni shechezkat hattame tame ad sheyyihye tahor vadday sheraglayim laddavar:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 7:
Ravim shehayu temee met befesach rishon im hayu miut hakkahal hare ellu nidchin lefesach sheni kishar hattemeim. aval im hayu rov hakkahal temee met o shehayu hakkohanim o kele sharet temeim tumat met enan nidchin. ella yakrivu kullan happesach betuma hattemeim im tehorim. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 6)</small> "vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam" yechidim nidchim veen hatztzibbur nidche. vedavar ze betumat hammet bilvad kemo shebbearnu beviat hammikdash:
Hayu hakkahal mechetza tehorim umechetza temee met. kullan osin barishon vehattehorim osin leatzman betohora vehattemeim osin leatzman betuma veochlin oto betuma. veim hayu temee hammet odfin al hattehorim afillu echad yaasu kullan betuma:
Hayu haanashim mechetza temee met umechetza tehorim uvizman sheatta mone hannashim bichlal haanashim yihyu harov tehorim. hattehorim osim et harishon vehattemein enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni. en osin rishon mippene shehen miut. veen osin et hashsheni mippene shehannashim bashsheni reshut venimtzeu hattemeim mechetza veen mechetza osin et hashsheni:
Hayu rov hakkahal zavim umetzoraim uvoale niddot umiutan temee met. otan temee met enan osin barishon lefi shehen miut veen osin hashsheni sheen hayechidim osin et hashsheni ella bizman sheasu rov hakkahal et harishon. vechan hoil velo asa rov hakkahal barishon lo yaasu ellu hammiut hattemeim lemet et hashsheni:
Hayu rov hakkahal temee met umiutan zavim vechayyotze bahen. temee met osin et harishon vehazzavin vechayyotze bahen enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni. enan osin barishon sheen nidchet betzibbur ella tumat hammet bilvad. veenan osin bashsheni sheen osin pesach sheni ella im ba harishon betohora. aval im naasa rishon betuma en sham pesach sheni:
Hayu shelish hakkahal tehorim ushelish zavim vechayyotze bahem ushelish temee met otan temee met en osin et harishon velo et hashsheni. enan osin rishon shehare hen muatim legabbe tehorim im hazzavim. uvashsheni lo yaasu shehare miut asu barishon kemo shebbearnu. ketzad meshaarim happesach leda im rov hakkahal temeim o tehorim. en meshaarin bechol haochlin sheefshar sheyyihyu esrim nimnin al pesach echad umeshallechin oto beyad echad lishchot alehen ella meshaarin bechol hannichnasim laazara vead shehen mibbachutz kodem shettikkanes kat harishona meshaarin otan:
Yachid shennitma bisfek reshut hayyachid kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo hare ze yiddache lefesach sheni kishar temee met. vetzibbur shennitma bisfek reshut hayyachid yaasu kullan betuma:
Pesach shehikrivuhu betuma hare ze neechol betuma. shemmittechillato lo ba ella laachila. veeno neechol lechol tame ella litmee met shennidchet lahem hattuma hazzot ulechayyotze bahen mittemee magga tumot. aval hattemeim shehattuma yotza alehen miggufan kegon zavim vezavot niddot veyoldot umetzoraim lo yochlu mimmennu veim achlu peturin. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehanneechol lithorin chayyavin alav mishshum tuma vehanneechol litmein en chayyavin alav mishshum tuma. afillu achlu temee hammet mehaemurim shello peturin. bamme devarim amurim shehappesach yeachel betuma keshennitmeu hatztzibbur kodem zerikat haddam. aval im nitmeu leachar zerikat haddam lo yeachel:
Shechatuhu betohora venitmeu rov hatztzibbur kodem zerika. zorek et haddam vehappesach lo yeachel. gezera shemma yittamu achar zerika beshana acheret veyochluhu betuma. hayu kele sharet temeim besheretz vechayyotze bo. hoil veenan metammein et haadam kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. af al pi shemmetammein et habbasar lo yaasuhu ella hattehorim veyeachel af al pi shehu tame. mutav sheyyeachel betumat basar shehi belav velo yochluhu temee hagguf shehem becharet kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 8: Achilat besar happesach belel chamishsha asar mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 8)</small> "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze tzeli esh umatztzot al merorim yochluhu":

Veen matztza umaror meakkevin. im lo matzu matztza umaror yotzin yede chovatan baachilat besar happesach levaddo. aval maror belo pesach eno mitzva shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 11)</small> "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu":

Mitzva min hammuvchar leechol besar happesach achilat sova. lefichach im hikriv shalme chagiga bearbaa asar. ochel mehen techilla veachar kach ochel besar happesach kede lisboa mimmennu. veim lo achal ella kezayit yatza yede chovato. vechen achilat besar pesach sheni belele chamishsha asar lechodesh iyyar mitzvat ase. shenneemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 9 11)</small> "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu":

Ushenehen enan neechalin ella tzeli esh. vehaochel mehen kezayit na o mevushshal belele pesachim loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal bammayim". achal na umevushshal keachat eno loke ella achat. lefi sheshshenehen nichlalot belav echad. achal mimmennu na o mevushshal mibbeod yom eno loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "ki im tzeli esh" beshaa shemmitzva leachlo tzali chayyav al achilat na umevushshal. aval mibbeod yom patur:
Achal mimmennu kezayit tzali mibbeod yom avar al mitzvat ase. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 8)</small> "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze". ballayla velo bayyom. velav habba mikkelal ase ase hu:

<small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "na" shehizhira alav tora hu habbasar shehitchil bo maase haur venitzla meat veeno rauy laachilat adam adayin. aval im achal mimmennu basar chay eno loke uvittel mitzvat ase. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "tzeli esh". ha sheeno tzali asur. tzalahu kol tzarko ad shennitcharech vaachalo patur:

<small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "mevushshal" shehizhira alav tora ben shennitbashshel bemayim ben shennitbashshel bishar mashkin o beme perot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "uvashel mevushshal" ribba hakkol:

Tzalahu veachar kach bishshelo. o shebbishshelo veachar kach tzalahu. o sheasahu tzeli kedera vaachalo chayyav. aval muttar lasuch oto beyayin veshemen udevash uvishar mashkin ume perot. chutz min hammayim. umuttar letabbel habbasar achar shennitzla bemashkim uveme perot:

En tzolin et happesach al gabbe kele even o kele mattachot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 8 9)</small> "tzeli esh" lo tzeli davar acher. lefichach im haya keli menukkav kede shettishlot bo haur tzolin alav. veen tzolin oto beshippud shel mattechet shehare hashshippud kullo cham vetzole mekomo:

Hissik et hattannur vegaraf et kol haesh vetalahu battannur vetzalahu hare ze asur sheen ze tzeli esh. chatacho vetalahu al gabbe gechalim hare ze tzeli esh. tzalahu al gabbe sid o charsit o chamme teverya hare ze asur sheen ze tzeli esh. ketzad tzolin oto. tochavo mittoch piv ad bet nekuvato beshippud shel etz vetolehu letoch hattannur vehaesh lematto vetole keraav uvene meav betannur chutza lo velo yittenem betocho shezze kemin bishshul hu. vshippud shel rimmon hayu borrin litzliyyato kede shello yizrok et memav vivashshelehu:
Naga habbasar becharso shel tannur yiklof et mekomo mippene shehu tzeli hacheres:
Nataf meratbo al hacheres vechazar alav yittol et mekomo shekkol hammarak vehallecha shettifrosh mimmennu kesheyyitztzale asura shehare enah besar tzali:
Nataf meratbo al hassolet yiklof et mekomo veyashlichennu:

Sacho beshemen shel teruma im chavurat hakkohanim yochlu. veim shel yisrael im chay hu yedichennu vinaggev veim tzali yiklof et hachitzon. sacho beshemen shel maaser sheni lo yaasennu damim al bene chavura sheen podin maaser sheni birushalayim kemo shebbearnu bimkomo. veen tzolin shene pesachim keachat mippene hattaarovot afillu gedi vetale:

Kevar bearonu bechamma mekomot sheen happesach neechol ella ad chatzot kede leharechik min haavera vedin tora sheyyochal kol hallayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. uchevar bearnu behilchot chametz umatztza shehu taun hallel bishat achilato vesheen bene chavura chozrin veochlin achar shinnirdemu beshena afillu bitchillat hallayla:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 9:
Kol haochel min happesach eno ochel ella bachavura achat veen motziin mimmennu min hachavura sheyyochal bah. vehammotzi mimmennu kezayit basar mechavura lachavura belel chamishsha asar loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 46)</small> "lo totzi min habbayit min habbasar chutza". vehu sheyyannichenu bachutz. shehotzaa ketuva bo keshabbat lefichach tzarich akira vehannacha kehotzaat shabbat. veen motzi achar motzi befesach shekkevan shehotzio harishon nifsal. min haagaf ulefanim kilfanim min haagaf velachutz kelachutz vehaagaf atzmo shehu ovi happetach kelachutz. hachallonot voovi hakketalim kilfanim. haggaggim vehaaliyyot enan bichlal habbayit:
Besar happesach sheyyatza chutz lachavurato ben bezadon ben bishgaga neesar baachila vahare hu kivsar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza chutz laazara o besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza chutz lechomot yerushalayim shehakkol kitrefa. velokin al achilato kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot. evar sheyyatza miktzato chotech habbasar veyored ad shemmaggia laetzem vekolef et habbasar kol shebbifnim yochal vechol shebbachutz yissaref. keshehu maggia laetzem chotech bekofitz im haya shear kadashim. veim haya pesach sheasur lishbor bo etzem kolef ad happerek umefarek haevar sheyyatza miktzato min happerek umashlicho lachutz:
Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot bevayit echad tzericha kol chavura mehen laasot lah hekkef shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 46)</small> "min habbasar chutza". mippi hashshemua lamdu shetztzarich litten lo chutza limkom achilato. veellu hofchin et penehen elach veochlin veellu hofchin et penehen elach veochlin kede shello yerau meoravim:
Hayu hammayim shemmozgim bo yenam beemtza habbayit ben shete hachavurot. keshehashshammash omed limzog kofetz et piv umachazir et panav ad shemmaggia etzel chavurato veachar kach ochel ma shebbefiv. sheasur laochel leechol bishte chavurot. umuttar lechalla lehachezir paneha mippene chavuratah veochelet mippene shehi bosha leechol bifnehem:
Shete chavurot shennifretza mechitztza mibbenehen enan ochlin. vechen im hayta chavura achat venaaset mechitztza benehen enan ochlin ad shettistallek. sheen happesach neechol bishte chavurot veenan neekarin mechavura lachavura:
Bene chavura shennichnesu shelosha mehen o yeter leechol pischehen velo bau shear bene chavura. im nichnesu beshaa shedderech bene adam leechol happesachim vechazar hameorer lechullan al hashshear velo bau hare ellu shennichnesu ochlin ad sheyyisbeu veen mamtinim lashshear. vaafillu bau hammitacharin achar kach umatzu ellu hashshelosha sheachlu hakkol en meshallemim lahen kede chelkam. aval im nichnesu shenayim bilvad hare ellu mamtinim. bamme devarim amurim bishat kenisatan leechol aval beet shenniftarin en adam tzarich lehametin lachavero afillu gamar echad bilvad milleechol yetze veeno tzarich lehametin:
Hammaachil kezayit min happesach ben mippesach rishon ben mippesach sheni lemumar laavoda zara o leger toshav o lesachir. hare ze over belo taase veeno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut. u <small>(Shemot 12 43)</small> "ven nechar" haamur battora ze haoved el nechar. veen maachilin mimmennu lenachri afillu ger toshav o sachir shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 45)</small> "toshav vesachir lo yochal bo":
Arel sheachal kezayit mibbesar happesach loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 48)</small> "kol arel lo yochal bo". bo hu sheeno ochel aval ochel hu matztza umaror. vechen muttar lehaachil matztza umaror leger toshav ulesachir:
Keshem shemmilat banav vaavadav meakkavto millishchot happesach kach meakkavto milleechol shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 44)</small> "umalta oto az yochal bo". ketzad. kana eved achar shennishchat happesach. o shehaya lo ben shello higgia zemanno lehimmol ella achar shechitat happesach. hare ze asur leechol ad sheyyamul otan. vechetzad yihye habben rauy lemila achar shechitat happesach velo yihye rauy kodem shechita. kegon shechalatzto chamma shetztzarich shivat yamim meet leet miyyom haveraato. uchegon shekkaava eno venirpet achar shechita. o shehaya tumtum venikra achar shechitat happesach venimtza zachar:
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 10:
Hashover etzem befesach tahor hare ze loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 46)</small> "veetzem lo tishberu vo". vechen neemar befesach sheni veetzem lo tishberu vo. aval pesach shebba betuma im shavar bo etzem eno loke. mippi hashshemua lamdu lo tishberu vo betahor velo betame. echad hashshover et haetzem belele chamishsha asar o sheshshavar bo etzem mibbeod yom o sheshshavar achar kamma yamim hare ze loke: 
Lefichach sorfin atzmot happesach bichlal hannotar mibbesaro kede shello yavou bahen lide takkala:
En chayyavin ella al shevirat etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar o sheyyesh bo moach. aval etzem sheen bo moach vesheen alav kezayit basar eno chayyav al shevirato. haya alav kezayit basar veshavar haetzem shello bimkom habbasar chayyav af al pi shehammakom sheshshavar panuy mibbesaro:
Hashshover achar hashshover beetzem echad loke:
Hassoref atzamot vehamechattech gidim eno chayyav mishshum shevirat etzem:
Pesach shehu na o mevushshal veshavar bo et haetzem loke. afillu nifsal betuma vitzia vechayyotze bahem yesh bo issur shevirat haetzem. bamme devarim amurim keshehayta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal. aval im lo hayta lo sheat hakkosher kegon shennitpaggel o naasa machashevet zeman o machashevet shinnuy hashshem. en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem:
Shavar etzem haalya eno loke shehare eno rauy laachila:
Hassechusim shehem kemo atzamim rakkim. hare ellu muttarin leachlan:
Haya gedi katan verach sheatzmotav rakkim lo yochal otan shezze shover etzem veim achal loke. sheechad hashshover etzem kashe o etzem rach. ze hakkelal kol shenneechol beshor haggadol achar sheyyitbashshel hu shemmuttar leechol kenegdo min haggedi harach achar tzeliyyato kegon rashe kenafayim vehassechusim:
Gidin harakkin shessofan lehikkashot af al pi shehen reuyin laachila atta veneechalin befesach en nimnin alehen. venimnin al moach shebbarosh mippene sheyyachol lehotzio belo shevirat etzem. veen nimnin al moach shebbekulit vehu haetzem hassatum mishshene rashav. shehare eno yachol lehotzio ella bishvirat etzem:
Kesheadam ochel et happesach chotech habbasar veochel vechotech haatzamot min happerek umefarkan im ratza. uchesheyyaggia legid hannashe motzio umannicho im shear haggidim vehaatzamot vehakkerumot sheyyotzin bishat achila. sheen menakkin oto kishar habbasar veen mechattechin oto ella tzolin oto shalem. veim chatacho chatichot chatichot kasher vehu shello yechsar evar. tzarich adam lehishtaddel shello yashir mibbesar happesach ad boker shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 10)</small> "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker". vechen bashsheni shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 12)</small> "lo yashiru mimmennu ad boker". veim hishir mimmennu ben barishon ben bashsheni avar belo taase. veeno loke al lav ze shehare nittak laase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 10)</small> "vehannotar mimmennu baesh tisrofu": 
Keshemmakrivin et happesach barishon makrivin immo shelamim beyom 14 min habbakar o min hatztzon. gedolim o ketannim. zecharim o nekevot kechol zivche hashshelamim. vezo hi hannikret chagigat arbaa asar veal ze neemar battora <small>(Devarim 16 2)</small> "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar". ematay meviin immo chagiga zo bizman shehu ba bechol uvetohora uvemuat. aval im chal yom arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat o shebba happesach betuma o shehayu happesachim merubbim en meviin immo chagiga. veen makrivin ella happesachim bilvad:
Chagigat arbaa asar reshut veenah chova. veneechelet lishne yamim velayla echad kechol zivche shelamim. veasur lehanniach mibbesar chagigat arbaa asar layyom hashshelishi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "velo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara lemanniach besar chagigat arbaa asar leyom shishsha asar. shenneemar labboker ad boker shel yom hashsheni. vehammotir eno loke ella yisrof hannotar mimmenna kishar hannotarim: 
Besar chagiga sheala im happesach al hashshulchan vechol hattavshilin haolim immo al hashshulchan mitbaarin immo. veenan neechalim ella ad chatzot kappesach atzmo gezera mippene hattaarovet:
Ma ben pesach rishon lefesach sheni. harishon asur bechametz beval yerae uval yimmatze. veeno nishchat al chametz. veen motziin mimmennu chutz lachavura. vetaun hallel baachilato. umeviin immo chagiga. veefshar sheyyavo betuma im nitma rov hakkahal tumat met kemo shebbearnu. aval pesach sheni chametz umatztza immo babbayit. veeno taun hallel baachilato. umotziin oto chutz lachavurato. veen meviin immo chagiga veeno ba betuma. ushenehem dochin et hashshabbat. uteunin hallel baasiyyatan veneechalin tzali bevayit echad al matztza umaror. veen motirin mehen. veen shovrin bahen et haetzem. velamma lo yishve hashsheni larishon lechol haddevarim meachar shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 12)</small> "kechol chukkat happesach yaasu". lefi shepperesh bo miktzat chukkat happesach. lelammed sheenah shava larishon ella bidvarim shennitparshu bo. vehen hammitzvot shebbegufo vehem chukkat happesach. shekkelal ze shenneemar bemitzrayim sheyyillakach happesach mibbeasor. veshehu taun haggaat dam baagudat ezov lammashkof velishte hammezuzot. vesheyyeachel bechippazon. en otan haddevarim nohagim ledorot velo naasu ella befesach mitzrayim bilvad:
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 1: Shalosh mitzvot ase nitztauu yisrael bechol regel mishshalosh regalim veellu hen. hariyya shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 17)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 23)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 16)</small> "yerae kol zechurecha". vehachagiga shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 15)</small> "tachog laAdonai elohecha". vehassimcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vesamachta bechaggecha". hariyya haamura battora hi shennira panav baazara beyom tov harishon shel chag veyavi immo karban ola ben min haof ben min habbehema. umi shebba laazara beyom rishon velo hevi ola lo dayyo shello asa mitzvat ase ella over al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 15)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "lo yerau fanay rekam". veeno loke al lav ze shehare lo asa maase. hachagiga haamura battora hi sheyyakriv shelamim beyom tov harishon shel chag bevoo leheraot. vehaddavar yadua sheen hashshelamim baim ella min habbehema. ushete mitzvot ellu shehen hariyya vehachagiga en hannashim chayyavot bahen. vehassimcha haamura bargalim hi sheyyakriv shelamim yeter al shalme chagiga. veellu hem hannikraim shalme simchat chagiga shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 7)</small> "vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha". venashim chayyavot bemitzva zo:

Hariyya vehachagiga en lahen shiur min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 17)</small> "ish kemattenat yado" vegomer. aval middivre sofrim shello yehe karban olat reiyya pachot mishsheve maa kesef velo shalme chagiga pachot mishsheve shete kesef. umitzva lehavi kefi ashro shenneemar kemattenat yado:

Shalme simcha lo natnu bahen chachamim shiur. beet sheyyaale adam lirushalayim lachog im hayu beyado karbenot hariyya yeviem o yaale immo kesef liknot bo hakkarban. veim en beyado kesef lo yavi sheve kesef afillu haya beyado sheve kamma zehuvim asur lo laalot rekam belo kesef velo karban. velamma asru sheyyaale beyado sheve kesef gezera shemma lo yimtza limkor o shemma yimmatzu hammaot sigim:

Mi shello hikriv beyom tov harishon olat reiyyato veshallemi chagigato hare ze makrivan bishar yemot haregel shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 15)</small> "shivat yamim tachog laAdonai elohecha" melammed shekkullan reuyin lachagiga vechullan tashlume rishon hem:
Umitzva lehakedim ulehakriv barishon. lo hikriv barishon ben shogeg ben mezid yakriv bashsheni. vechol hammeacher hare ze megunne vealav neemar <small>(Tzefanya 3 18)</small> "nuge mimmoed asafti":
Avar haregel velo chag eno chayyav beacharayuto veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Kohelet 1 15)</small> "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon":

Mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag hassukkot chogeg et kol haregel uvayyom tov haacharon shehu shemini veaf hashshemini tashlume rishon hu. vechen mi shello chag beyom chag hashshavuot chogeg kol shiva veyesh lo tashlumin kol sheshet yamim shelleachar chag hashshavuot. vedavar ze mippi hashshemua neemar shechag hashshavuot kechag hammatztzot letashlumin:

Olat reiyya veshalme chagiga enan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma lefi sheen lahen zeman kavua kekarbenot hatztzibbur. sheim eno chogeg hayyom chogeg lemachar kemo shebbearnu. aval dochin et yom tov veaf al pi sheen makrivin beyom tov nedarim unedavot makrivin olat reiyya veshalme chagiga veshalme simcha sheen ellu nedarim unedavot ella chovot:

Keshemmakriv hammakriv olat reiyyato veshalme chagigato vesimchato beyom tov. somech alehen bechol kocho kederech sheose bishar hayyamim. af al pi shessemicha enah meakkevet kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot lo gazru aleha mishshum shevut:

Hammafrish olat reiyyato umet. hayyorshin chayyavin lahaviah. muttar lehakeriv bechullo shel moed nedarim unedavot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem levad minnidrechem venidvotechem" mikkelal shekkerevin baregel. <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "leolotechem" kemo olat metzora veolat yoledet. <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "uleminchotechem" lehavi minchat chote uminchat kenaot. <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "uleshalmechem" lerabbot shalme nazir hakkol kerevin bammoed veen kerevin beyom tov:

Umi shehaya lo ochlim merubbim unechasim muatin mevi shalme chagiga merubbin veolot reiyya muatin. hayu lo ochlin muatin unechasim merubbin mevi olot reiyya merubbot veshalme chagiga muatot. hayu ze veze muat al ze amru lo yifchot mimmaa leola ushete kesef lishlamim. ze veze merubbe al ze neemar <small>(Devarim 16 17)</small> "kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach":
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 2: Nashim vaavadim peturin min hariyya. vechol haanashim chayyavim biriyya chutz mecheresh veillem veshote vekatan vesuma vechigger vetame vearel. vechen hazzaken vehachole veharach veheanog meod sheenam yecholim laalot al raglehen kol ellu haachad asar peturin. ushear kol haanashim chayyavin biriyya. hacheresh af al pi shehu medabber afillu cheresh beazno achat patur min hariyya. vechen hassuma beeno achat. o chigger beraglo achat patur. haillem af al pi shehu shomea patur. tumtum veanderoginus peturin mippene shehen sefek ishsha. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin patur mippene tzad avdut shebbo. uminnayin shekkol ellu peturin min hariyya. hare hu omer <small>(Shemot 23 17)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 23)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 16)</small> "yerae kol zechurecha" lehotzi et hannashim. umitzvat ase sheen hannashim chayyavot bah en haavadim chayyavim bah. veod hare neemar bevo chol yisrael lehotzi haavadim. veneemar <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "bevo chol yisrael leraot". keshem shehen bain leheraot lifne Adonai kach hem baim lirot hadar kadsho uvet shechinato. lehotzi suma sheeno roe. afillu nismet eno achat shehare en reiyyato shelema. vesham neemar <small>(Devarim lo 12)</small> "lemaan yishmeu". lehotzi mi sheen lo shemia gemura. <small>(Devarim lo 12)</small> "ulemaan yilmedu". lehotzi mi sheeno medabber. shekkol hametzuvve lilmod metzuvve lelammed. veneemar <small>(Shemot 34 24)</small> "baalotcha leraot et pene Adonai" mi sheyyachol laalot beraglav lehotzi chigger vechole vezaken veanog. uchevar bearnu behilchot biat hammikdash sheen hattame rauy levia vechen hearel maus ketame:

Hamekammetz vehu shemmelachto lekabbetz tzoat kelavim vechayyotze bahen leabbed haorot o lirfua. vechen hametzaref nechoshet bemachtzav shello vehaabbedanin. af al pi shehen meusin mippene melachtan hare ellu metaharin gufan umalbushan veolin bichlal yisrael leraot:

Kol katan sheyyachol leechoz beyado shel aviv velaalot miyyerushalayim lehar habbayit aviv chayyav lehaaloto uleheraot bo kede lechannecho bemitzvot shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 17)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 23)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 16)</small> "yerae kol zechurecha". veim haya hakkatan chigger o suma o cheresh afillu beachat eno chayyav lechannecho af al pi shehu rauy lirfua sheillu haya gadol vehu kach haya patur kemo shebbearnu:

Kol hachayyav biriyya chayyav bachagiga vechol happatur min hariyya patur min hachagiga. vechullan chayyavin besimcha. chutz mecheresh shote vekatan vearel vetame. cheresh shote vekatan mippene sheenan bene chiyyuv hare hen peturin mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. vearel vetame mippene sheenan ochlim bekadashim veenan reuyin levia kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat hammikdash uvehilchot maase hakkarbanot:

Mi shehaya chigger o suma beyom rishon venitrappe bashsheni. patur min hariyya umin hachagiga. shebbeyom chovato haya patur. shekkol yemot hechag tashlume rishon hen kemo shebbearnu. vechen im nitma belele yom tov harishon af al pi shettahar lemachar patur. aval im nitma beyom rishon hare ze chayyav lehavi chagigato ureiyyato betoch yeme haregel kesheyyithar:

Mi shebba laazara betoch yeme hechag eno chayyav lehavi ola beyado bechol et sheyyikkanes. shezze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 15)</small> "velo yerau fanay rekam" eno ella beikkar haregel bilvad shehu yom rishon o tashlume rishon. veim hevi bechol et sheyyavi mekabbelin mimmennu umakrivin otah leshem olat reiyya. shehariyya en lah shiur:

Hifrish eser behemot lachagigato vehikriv mehen miktzatan barishon ufasak. shuv eno chozer umakriv hashshear shehare shiyyer otam. veim lo pasak ella dechako hayyom velo yachol lehakeriv hayyom makriv hashshear lemachar:

Olat reiyya enah baa ella min hachullin kishar hakkarbanot sheadam chayyav bahen. aval shalme chagiga baot mimmeot maaser sheni hameoravot im meot chullin. lokeach min hattaarovet behema umakrivah shalme chagiga. vehu sheyyihye shiur achila rishona min hachullin. mippene sheshshalme chagiga chova vechol shehu chova eno ba ella min hachullin:
Veyotze adam yede chovat shalme chagiga bemaasar behema. veen meviin oto beyom tov gezera shemma yeasser beyom tov:

Yotzin yisrael yede chovat shalme simcha bindarim unedavot uvemaasar behema. vehakkohanim bechattat uveasham uvivchor uvechaze veshok. shemmitzva zo hi lismoach baachilat basar lifne Adonai vahare achlu. aval en yotzin yede chovatan lo beofot velo bimnachot sheenan basar hamesammeach. kevar bearnu bifsachim shechagigat arbaa asar reshut. lefichach en adam yotze bah yede chovat chagiga ella yotze bah chovat simcha:
Mi shehayu lo shalme neder o nedava ushechatan meerev yom tov af al pi sheachalan beyom tov eno yotze bah yede chovat chagiga sheenah baa ella min hachullin aval yatza bah yede chovat simcha:
Af al pi sheshshechatan kodem haregel. hoil veochel mehen baregel yatza yede chovato sheeno tzarich lishchot shalme simcha bishat simcha:
Lo yavi adam toda beyom arbaa asar mippene hechametz shebbah sheen meviin kadashim levet happesul. veim hevi yotze bah yede chovat simcha kemo shebbearnu:

Haomer hare alay toda sheetze bah yede chovati leshem chagiga. chayyav lehavi toda veeno yotze bah yede chagiga sheen chagiga baa ella min hachullin. kesheyyizbach adam shalme chagiga veshalme simcha lo yihye ochel hu uvanav veishto bilvad vidamme sheyyaase mitzva gemura. ella chayyav lesammeach haaniyyim vehaumlalim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vehallevi vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana". maachil hakkol umashkan kefi ashro. umi sheachal zevachav velo simmeach ellu immo alav neemar <small>(Hoshea 9 4)</small> "zivchehem kelechem onim lahem kol ochlav yittammau ki lachmam lenafsham". umitzva belevi yoter min hakkol lefi sheen lo lo chelek velo nachala veen lo mattanot babbasar lefichach tzarich lezammen leviyyim al shulchano ulesammecham o yitten lahem mattenot basar im maaser shellahem kede sheyyimtzeu bo tzarchehem. vechol haozev et hallevi millesammecho veshohe mimmennu maasrotav bargalim over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 19)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen taazov et hallevi":
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 3:
Mitzvat ase lehakehil kol yisrael anashim venashim vetaf bechol motzae shemitta baalotam laregel velikrot beaznehem min hattora parashiyyot shehen mezarzot otan bemitzvot umechazzekot yedehem bedat haemet. shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 10)</small> "mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot" <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "bevo chol yisrael leraot" vegomer <small>(Devarim lo 12)</small> "hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf vegercha asher bisharecha" vegomer:
Kol happatur min hariyya patur mimmitzvat hakehel chutz min hannashim vehattaf vehearel. aval hattame patur mimmitzvat hakehel shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "bevo chol yisrael" veze eno rauy levia. vehaddavar barur shehattumtum vehaanderoginus chayyavin shehare hannashim chayyavot:
Ematay hayu korin. bemotzae yom tov harishon shel chag hassukkot shehu techillat yeme chullo shel moed shel shana sheminit. vehammelech hu sheyyikra beaznehem. uveezrat hannashim hayu korin. vekore keshehu yoshev veim kara meummad hare ze meshubbach. mehechan hu kore mittechillat chummash elle haddevarim ad sof parashat shema umedalleg li<small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" vegomer umedalleg leasser teasser vekore me <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "asser teasser" al hasseder ad sof berachot ukelalot ad <small>(Devarim 28 69)</small> "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev" ufosek: 
Ketzad hu kore. tokin bachatzotzrot bechol yerushalayim kede lehakehil et haam. umeviin bima gedola veshel etz hayta umaamidin otah beemtza ezrat nashim vehammelech ole veyoshev aleha kede sheyyishmeu keriato vechol yisrael haolim lachog mitkabbetzin sevivav. vechazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan usegan lechohen gadol vechohen gadol lammelech kede lehaddero berov bene adam. vehammelech mekabbelo keshehu omed veim ratza yeshev ufoteach veroe umevarech kederech shemmevarech kol kore battora bevet hakkeneset. vekore happarashiyyot sheamarnu ad shehu gomer vegolel umevarech leachareha kederech shemmevarchin bevatte kenesiyyot umosif sheva berachot veellu hen. retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael vechulei. modim anachnu lach vechulei. atta bechartanu mikkol haammim vechulei ad mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim kederech shemmevarchin battefilla. hare shalosh berachot kematbean. reviit mitpallel al hammikdash sheyyaamod vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai hashshochen betziyyon. chamishit mitpallel al yisrael shettaamod malchutam vechotem bah habbocher beyisrael. shishshit mitpallel al hakkohanim sheyyirtze hael avodatam vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hakkohanim. sheviit mitchannen umitpallel bah kefi ma shehu yachol vechotem bah hosha Adonai et ammecha yisrael sheammecha tzerichin lehivvasha baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:
Hakkeria vehabberachot bilshon hakkodesh. shenneemar <small>(Devarim lo 11)</small> "tikra et hattora hazzot" bilshonah af al pi sheyyesh sham loazot:
