Vegerim sheenan makkirin chayyavin lehachin libbam ulehakshiv aznam lishmoa beema veyira vegila birada keyom shennittena bo besinay. afillu chachamim gedolim sheyyodim kol hattora kullah chayyavin lishmoa bechavvana gedola yetera. umi sheeno yachol lishmoa mechavven libbo likria zo shello kevaah hakkatuv ella lechazzek dat haemet veyire atzmo keillu atta nitztavva bah umippi haggevura shomah. shehammelech shaliach hu lehashemia divre hael:
Yom hakehel shechal lihyot beshabbat meacharin oto leachar hashshabbat. mippene tekiat hachatzotzrot vehattechinnot sheenan dochin et hashshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 1: Mitzvat ase lehaferish kol peter rechem hazzecharim ben baadam ben bivhema tehora ben mimmin hachamor. ben shehayu shelemim ben shehayu terefot. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "kaddesh li chol bechor peter kol rechem bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema". vechullan lakkohanim:

Bechor adam uvechor chamor nifdim ufidyonam lakkohanim. uvechor behema tehora nishchat baazara kishar kadashim kallim. zorkin damo umaktir emurav kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot ushear habbasar neechol lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde" <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "ach bechor shor" <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "lo tifde kodesh hem" <small>(Bamidbar 18 18)</small> "uvesaram yihye lach":

Bechor behema tehora shehu baal mum ben shennolad bemumo ben shennafal bo mum achar shehaya tamim hare hu lakkohen im ratza ochlo bechol makom o mochro o maachilo lemi sheyyirtze afillu lenachri mippene shehu chullin. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 21)</small> "vechi yihye vo mum pisseach o ivver" vegomer <small>(Devarim 15 22)</small> "hattame vehattahor yachdav yochalennu katztzevi vechaayyal" vahare hu nichse kohen:

Mitzva lehakedish bechor behema tehora veyomar hare ze kodesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "takdish laAdonai elohecha" veim lo hikdisho hare ze mitkaddesh meelav ukedushshato merechem hi:

Mitzvat bechor behema tehora noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz veen meviin bechorot michutza laaretz laaretz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha" <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha". mimmakom sheatta mevi maasar dagan atta mevi bechor bakar vatzon umimmakom sheen atta mevi maasar dagan i atta mevi bechor bakar vatzon ella hare hu kechullin veyeachel bemumo. veim hevi en mekabbelin mimmennu velo yikkarev ella yeachel bemumo:
Mitzva zo noheget ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit kemo maasar dagan. veenah noheget bemukdashin keshehen bikdushshatan kodem sheyyippadu ben kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit:

Hakkol chayyavin bivchor behema tehora kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. veaf al pi shehabbechor lakkohen im nolad lo bechor makriv damo veemurav kemo shebbearnu veochel shear habbasar betorat bechor. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor asher yivvaled bivkarcha uvetzoncha" vegomer. aval bechor adam uvechor behema temea kohanim uleviyyim peturin kemo shebbearnu behilchot mattenot kehunna:

Habbechor neechol betoch shenato ben tamim ben baal mum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 20)</small> "lifne Adonai elohecha tochalennu shana beshana" <small>(Devarim 15 21)</small> "vechi yihye bo mum" <small>(Devarim 15 22)</small> "bisharecha tochalennu". umeematay mone lo. im tam hu mone lo miyyom shemini shehu rauy lehakerava veim nolad baal mum mone lo miyyom shennolad. vehu shekkalu lo chodashav shehare nire laachila beyom ledato. aval im lo yada bevadday shekkalu lo chodashav mone lo miyyom shemini:

Nolad lo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayyemo kol shenem asar chodesh. nolad lo mum besof shenato muttar lekayyemo sheloshim yom miyyom shennafal bo hammum veaf al pi shehu mitacher leachar shenato. ketzad. kegon shennafal bo mum bachamishsha asar yom lifne gemar shenato mashlimin lo chamishsha asar achar shenato. nolad lo mum achar shenato eno rashshay lekayyemo ella ad sheloshim yom veyeachel:
Habbechor bazzeman hazze mannicho ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel:

Vead shello nire lehareoto lechacham rashshay lekayyemo shetayim veshalosh shanim. umishshennire lehareoto lechacham. im nolad bo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayyemo kol shenem asar chodesh. nolad achar shenato mekayyemo sheloshim yom:

Shana shel bechor hi shenat levana temima shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom. veim hayta shana meubberet nitabbera lo umone lo shelosha asar chodesh. noldu lo shene telaim echad bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon veechad berosh chodesh adar sheni. ze shennolad berosh chodesh adar sheni kevan shehiggia yom rishon baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana veze shennolad bachatzi adar rishon lo alta lo shana ad chatzi adar shel shana habbaa hoil venolad bechodesh haibbur monin oto lo:

Avar veicher habbechor leachar shenato af al pi shehu over belo taase im haya tam hare ze lo nifsal ella makrivo veim haya baal mum shochato bechol makom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha" makkish bechor lemaaser ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah:

En notnin et habbechor lakkohen kesheyyivvaled sheen zo gedulla lakkohen. ella yetappel bo bealav ad sheyyagdil meat veyittenennu lakkohen. vead kamma yisrael chayyavin lehittafel babbechor. behema dakka sheloshim yom uvegassa chamishshim yom. veim amar lo hakkohen tenehu li betoch zeman ze vaani atappel leatzmi eno rashshay litteno lo shezze kemo mesayyea al mattenotav uchevar bearnu bitrumot shehakkohanim hamesayyein bevet haggoranot uvevet hammitbachayim uvetoch haroim en notnin lahem mattenotehen bischaran:

Haya habbechor baal mum veamar lo betoch zeman ze tenehu li sheochalennu atta. o shehaya tamim veamar lo tenehu li betoch zeman ze sheakrivennu atta hare ze notno lo. veyerae li shehabbechor noten lechol kohen sheyyirtze:

Kohen sheachal kezayit mibbechor tamim chutz lirushalayim loke min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha". vechen zar sheachal kezayit mibbechor ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika loke. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara af lezar sheachal bechor ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika:

Habbechor en podin oto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "ach bechor shor o vechor kesev o vechor ez lo tifde". vechen en mochrin oto keshehu tam shekkevan shehu omed lekarban en lakkohen bo zechut kede lemachro. uvazzeman hazze sheen bayit hoil vehu omed laachila hare hu muttar lemachro veaf al pi shehu tamim ben lechohen ben leyisrael:

Bechor baal mum yesh lakkohen lemachro bechol zeman ben lifne habbayit ben shello lifne habbayit. ben chay ben shachut. ucheshehu mocher besar bechor baal mum mochro babbayit aval lo bashshuk kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach aval besar bechor tamim eno nimkar mippene shehu besar kodesh. vechohanim shennimnu im habbechor muttarin lishkol mana keneged mana:
Hammafshit bechor baal mum hare ze muttar lehafeshito bee ze derech sheyyirtze. im ratza leharegil margil. vechen shear pesule hammukdashin im ratza lehafeshit min haregel mafshit:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 2: Kol hammumim hakkevuim happoslin et hakodashim venifdim alehen. im nafal echad mehen bivchor hare ze nishchat alav bechol makom. uchevar bearnu otan hammumin behilchot issure mizbeach sheharauy mehen lihyot bezachar shishshim veshiva:

Vechol haddevarim shemmaninu sham sheen hakkarban min hammuvchar veen hakkadashim kerevin bahen velo nifdin alehen kach en habbechor nishchat alehen velo karev ella yihye omed ad sheyyivvaled lo mum kavua. vechen im nolad bivchor mum over hare ze eno nishchat bechol makom velo karev ella yihye roe ad sheyyippol bo mum kavua veyishshachet alav:
Vechen im neevda bo avera. o sheharag beed echad. o al pi habbealim. o shehuktza o neevad. yire ad sheyyippol bo mum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach:
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav shenehen enan bechor. harishon mippene sheeno peter rechem vehaacharon mippene shekkedamo acher. afillu yatza nekeva derech dofen vezachar derech rechem eno bechor:

Bechor shehu anderoginus en bo kedushsha kelal. vahare hu kinkeva sheen bo lakkohen kelum. veovdim bo vegozzim oto kishar hachullin. nolad tumtum hare ze sefek bechor veyeachel bemumo livalav. ben shehetil mayim mimmekom zichrut ben shehetil mimmekom nakvut:

Rachel sheyyalda kemin ez. o ez sheyyalda kemin rachel patur min habbechora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "ach bechor shor" ad sheyyihye hu shor uvechoro shor. veim haya bo miktzat simane immo hare ze bechor vehu baal mum kavua sheen lecha mum gadol mishshinnuy beriyyato. afillu para sheyyalda kemin chamor veyesh bo miktzat simane para hare ze bechor lakkohen hoil umin hachamor yesh bo din bechor. aval im yalda min sus o gamal af al pi sheyyesh bo miktzat simane para hare hu sefek bechor lefichach yeachel labbealim. veim tefaso kohen en motziin miyyado:
Hammattil mum bivchor hoil veasa avera konsin oto veeno nishchat al mum ze ad sheyyippol bo mum acher meelav. veim met ze hachote muttar livno leshochoto al mum sheasa aviv shello kansu beno acharav:

Hirgil labbechor sheyyippol bo mum kegon shennatan devela al azno ad shebba kelev unetalah vechatach azno. o shehalach ben barzel vaashashiyyot shel zechuchit kede shettikkata yado veniktea. o sheamar lenachri lehattil bo mum. hare ze lo yishchot alav. ze hakkelal kol mum shennaasa ledato asur lo lishchot alav veim naasa shello ledato hare ze shochet alav:
Amar illu nafal bivchor ze mum hayiti shochato veshama hannachri veasa bo mum hare ze shochet alav shehare lo naasa bedato:

Reinuhu sheasa maase hammargil lehattil bo mum venafal bo mum veen anu yodin im nitkavven lemum ze o lo nitkavven. hare ze lo yishchot alav. ketzad. kegon shennatan lo seorim bemakom dachuk mesorag bekotzim vechevan sheachal nechlak sefato afillu haya chaver hare ze lo yishchot alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Haya bechor rodef et haadam uvaato kede letardo vaafillu baat bo mippene sherdafo mikkodem venaasa bo mum bivita zo hare ze yishchat alav:
Ketannim shehittilu mum bivchor derech sechok vechen hannachri sheasa ledato hare ze yishchot alav. veim asu kede lehattiro lo yishchot alav:
Bechor sheachazo dam yakkiz. uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot bo mum. veim naasa bo mum behakkaza zo hare ze nishchat alav:

Muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyetze laavir haolam veyishchat alav. bamme devarim amurim bazzeman hazze sheen sham bayit mippene shessofo leheachel bemumo. aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam asur:
Ed sheheid mippi ed achar shemmum ze nafal shello ledaat neeman. afillu ishsha neemenet lomar befanay nafal mum ze meelav veyishchat alav:

Kol hammumin haruyin lavo bide adam neeman haroe alehen lomar mealehen naflu velo naasu bechavvana veyishchat alehen. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya haroe yisrael vehabbechor beyad hakkohen. aval im haya haroe kohen vehabbechor adayin hu beyad bealav hayyisreeli. hare ze eno neeman vechoshdin oto shemma hu hittil bo mum kede sheyyittenennu lo:

Kohen sheheid lechohen acher shemmum ze meelav nafal neeman veen choshshin lahen shemma hem gomlim ze et ze. shekkol hakkohanim chashudin lehattil mum bivchor kede leachlo bachutz ulefichach en neemanin al yede atzman. aval chavero meid lo, sheen adam chote leacher. afillu banav uvene beto shel kohen meidin lo al habbechor aval lo ishto mippene shehi kegufo:

Bechor shehaya beyad kohen venafal bo mum veheid alav ed echad shezze hammum meelav nafal veen anu yodim im mum ze shochatin alav et habbechor o en shochatin alav uva hakkohen shehu beyado veamar hereti mum ze lemumche vehittiro lishchita hare ze neeman. veen choshshin shemma lo herahu veshemma bechor tam hu shello nechshedu lishchot kadashim bachutz mippene shehu avon karet kemo shebbearnu:

Vechen neeman hakkohen lomar al bechor baal mum bechor ze netano li yisrael bemumo velo nafal birshuti kede lachush lo shemma hu hittilo. shehaddavar asuy lehiggalot vehu mityare shemma yishalu bealav veyomar tamim haya beet shennetanuhu lo:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 3:
En shochatin et habbechor ella al pi mumche shennatan lo hannasi shebbeeretz yisrael reshut veamar lo hatter bechorot bemuman. afillu haya mum gadol vegaluy lakkol lo yattiro ella mumche shennatal reshut. vechol habbechorot adam roe chutz mibbechore atzmo:
Im en sham mumche vehaya hammum min hammumin haggeluyin hammuvhakin. kegon shennismet eno. o niktea yado. o nishbera raglo. hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset. vechen bechor sheyyatza lechutza laaretz venafal bo mum muvhak. hare ze yuttar al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset:
En roin et habbechor leyisrael ad sheyyihye kohen immo. shemma yomar lo hammumche mum hu umuttar lishchot alav veyelech veyishchatennu leatzmo velo yittenennu lakkohen. sheaf al pi sheeno chashud leechol kadashim bachutz. chashud hu ligzol mattenot kehunna. lefichach im haya chacham veyadua shehu medakdek al atzmo roin lo. haya hammum galuy lakkol kegon shenniktea yado o raglo. hoil vehevio lechacham hammumche hare ze bechezkat medakdek al atzmo lefichach roin lo af al pi sheen immo kohen:
Hashshochet et habbechor veachar kach hera et mumo af al pi shehu mum galuy sheeno mishtanne bishchita kegon shennechtecha yado o raglo hoil venishchat shello al pi mumche hare ze asur veyikkaver kivchor shemmet:
Bechor shehayta lo betza achat ushene kisim. uvedako hammumche vehoshivuhu al haregozo umiachu velo yatzat betza sheniyya vehittiro hammumche venishchat venimtza hashsheniyya devuka bakkesalim hare ze muttar hoil umiachu. aval im lo nimach af al pi shennishchat al pi mumche hare ze yikkaver:
Mi sheeno mumche veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv. hare ze yikkaver vishallem mibbeto. vechamma meshallem. revia ledakka umechetza legassa. umippene ma lo yeshallem kol damav mippene shekkansu et baal habbehema kede shello yashhenna velo yegaddel behema dakka beeretz yisrael:
Hannotel secharo lihyot roe bechorot en shochatin al piv ella im ken haya mumche gadol veyadu bo chachamim sheen kemoto ufasku lo sachar al hariyya vehabbikkur ben shennimtza bo mum ben shennimtza tamim. velo yittol sachar al behema zo chutz mippaam achat veroe otah leolam kol zeman shemmeviin otah kede shello yavo lide chashad:
Hechashud al habbechorot lemachran leshem chullin en lokchin mimmennu afillu besar tzevaim mippene shehu dome livsar egel. veen lokchim mimmennu orot sheenan avudim afillu shel nekeva shemma yachtoch zichruto veyomar or nekeva hu. veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer afillu melubban veen tzarich lomar tzoi. aval lokchin mimmennu tauuy ulevadin veorot avudim. sheeno meabbed or bechor tamim mippene shehu mefached lashhoto etzlo shemma yishmeu haddayyanim veyiknesuhu kefi risho:
Hashshochet et habbechor umecharo venoda shello herahu lemumche. ma sheachlu achlu veyachzir lahem et haddamim. uma shello neechal yikkaver veyachzir et haddamim. vechen haddin bemaachil et hatterefa kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar:
Bechor shennimtza terefa im tamim hu venimtza terefa achar shehufshat haor yissaref kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin vehabbasar yikkaver. veim bemumo nishchat habbasar yikkaver veyehanu hakkohanim beoro. vehu shennishchat al pi mumche:
Habbechor shenneechal besaro kahalacha ben tamim ben baal mum. keshem shemmuttar lehanot beoro kach nehenin begizzotav. aval kol tzemer shennigzaz mimmennu keshehu chay afillu nashar hare hu asur bahanaa. vaafillu nashar mimmennu achar shennafal bo mum. vaafillu achar shechitato veen tzarich lomar achar mitato shehare oto hatztzemer shennashar mimmennu mechayyim beissuro omed. vechen bemaasar behema. uchevar bearnu behilchot meila shello gazru gezera zo ella al habbechor veal hammaaser bilvad mippene sheenan bain lechappara shemma yashhem etzlo kede likkach kol hatztzemer sheyyinshor mehem. uchevar bearnu shemmitzva leachlo toch shenato ben tamim ben baal mum:
Bechor shehaya bo tzemer meduvlal ushechato. et shehu nire immo min haggizza muttar bahanaa. veet sheeno nire immo vehu hatztzemer sheikkaro hafuch kelappe rosho asur. shezze kemo shennashar mechayyim:
Gizzat bechor afillu baal mum shennitarva begizze chullin afillu achat bechamma alafim hakkol asurim. hare hu davar chashuv umekaddesh bechol shehu. haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer habbechor beveged yiddalek. mitztzemer hammukdashin mekaddesh bechol shehu:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 4: Vehemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bivchora. lo neemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "bekarcha vetzonecha" ella lemaet shuttafut hannachri sheim haya shuttaf bappara o baubbar afillu haya lannachri echad meelef baem o bavvalad hare ze patur min habbechora. haya lo beechad mishshenehem evar echad kegon yad o regel. roin kol sheillu yechatech vehaya baal mum hare ze patur. veim efshar sheyyechatech evar hannachri velo yippasel. hare ze chayyav bivchora:
Hallokeach ubbar parato shel nachri. o hammocher ubbar parato lenachri. af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze patur min habbechora. veen konsin oto al davar ze:

Hamekabbel behema min hannachri lihyot metappel bah vehavveladot benehem. o nachri shekkibbel miyyisrael kaze. hare ellu peturim min habbechora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "peter kol rechem bivne yisrael" ad sheyyihye hakkol miyyisrael:

Hamekabbel tzon min hannachri bemamon katzuv ufasak immo sheyyihye hassachar benehem veim pichatu pichatu leyisrael. af al pi shebbirshut yisrael hem vahare hem kekinyano hoil veim lo yimtza hannachri etzlo mamon acher ligbot mimmennu yigbe min habbehemot haellu umivvaldotehen naasa kemo sheyyesh lo acharayut alehen veal valdotehen vahare yad hannachri beemtza ufeturin min habbechora hem uvaldotehen. aval valde veladot chayyavin shehare shel yisrael hem veen lannachri reshut alehen:

Yisrael shennatan maot lenachri vekana lo bahen behema minnachri bedinehen af al pi shello mashach kana vechayyevet bivchora. vechen im kana hannachri miyyisrael bedinehem venatan maot af al pi shello mashach kana ufetura mibbechora:
Ger shennitgayyer veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer yalda parato o achar shennitgayyer hare ze bechor missafek:
Hallokeach behema min hannachri veen yadua im bikkera o lo bikkera veyalda etzlo hare ze sefek bechor veyeachel bemumo labbealim veeno lakkohen shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:

Lakach behema menika min hannachri eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret hi menika ella hare zo bechezkat sheyyalda. vaafillu haya ze shemmenika kemo min acher vaafillu kemin chazir hare zo petura min habbechora. vechen behema shehi cholevet petura min habbechora sherov habbehemot enan cholvot ella im ken kevar yaldu:

Hallokeach behema miyyisrael hare zo bechezkat shebbikkera ad sheyyodio hammocher sheadayin lo yalda. sheen hayyisrael shotek vegorem lo leechol kadashim bachutz vadday shebbikkera ulefichach mecharah setam:

Behema dakka shehippila ubbar sheadayin lo nitbaer tzurato harebe venikkeret lakkol vezehu hannikra tinnuf. im amru haroim ubbar hu ella shennifseda tzurato hare zo petura min habbechora vetzarich lehareoto leroe chacham. lefichach hallokeach behema min hannachri afillu hayta ketanna veyalda etzlo betoch shenatah hare ze sefek bechor shemma tinnuf hippila birshut hannachri. vechen behema gassa shehippila shilya hare zo siman valad sheen shilya belo valad veniftera min habbechora. umuttar lehashelich otah hashshilya lakkelavim sheen mitkaddesh bivchora ella zachar vechezkat hannoladim mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot. uchevar bearnu shehazzachar sheen bo miktzat simane immo eno mitkaddesh bivchora venimtza miut hannoladim hen hammitkaddeshin bivchora veen choshshin lemiut. aval behemat kadashim shehippila shilya tikkaver [shehannekevot bah kizcharim]:

Behema gassa shehippila chararat dam hare zo niftera min habbechora shechezkatah shehavvalad betochah verava alav haddam vehifsido uvittelo. vekovrin charara zo kemo nefel mevakkeret af al pi sheen charara zo kedosha. velamma kovrin otah kede lefarsem haddavar shenniftera min habbechora:

Kevar bearnu beinyan nidda shehavvalad baadam nigmar learbaim yom vehammappelet lefachot mearbaim eno valad. aval velad behema lo amdu chachamim al minyan hayyamim sheyyiggamer bo. aval amru shehammappelet tinnuf enah mitabberet acharav velo mekabbelet valad acher lefachot mishsheloshim yom:
Behema sheyyatza melea uvaa rekanit habba achar ken bechor missafek shemma davar sheeno poter bivchora hippila. veen lenifle behema petirat rechem ad sheyyaagilu rosh kefika shel erev:

Mavkeret hammaksha leled mechattech evar umashlich lakkelavim vehabba acharav bechor. yatza rubbo hare ze yikkaver veniftera min habbechora. veim chatach evar vehinnicho evar vehinnicho ad shehishlim rubbo hare kol haevarim tzerichin kevura. veniftera min habbechora kevan sheyyatza rubbo ben shalem ben mechuttach vahare hu lefanenu nitkaddesh lemafrea:

Yatza shelish umecharo lenachri vechazar veyatza shelish acher. nitkaddesh lemafrea veniftera min habbechora. yatza shelish derech dofen ushene shelishim derech rechem eno kadosh sheharov harishon lo yatza derech rechem ulemafrea hu mitkaddesh:

Yatza miut evar gadol vahare ze hayyotze rubbo shel ubbar niftar min habbechora veyikkaver hayyotze. yatza chatzi haubbar vehu rubbo shel evar hayyotze hare ze safek im niftera min habbechora o lo niftera lefichach habba acharav sefek bechor:
Bechor shekkeracho besiv vehotzio velo naga barechem o shekkeracho beshilyat behema acheret o shennichrecha alav achoto veyatza hoil velo naga barechem mikkol makom hare ze sefek bechor:
Hidbik shene rechamim ze laze veyatza mizze venichnas laze hare ze safek im niftera min habbechora habbehema shennichnas bah habbechor shehare peter rechem o lo niftera ad sheyyiftor rachmah veladah:
Niftechu katle bet harechem veyatza hare ze safek im negiat rechem mekaddeshet o aviro:
Neekru katle bet harechem [venitlu] betzavvaro hare ze safek im bimkomo mekaddesh o mekaddesh af chutz limkomo:
Nigmemu katle bet harechem eno kadosh. nifratz miktzato veomed merubbe al happarutz veyatza derech happarutz. o shehaya happarutz merubbe al haomed veyatza derech haomed hare ze sefek bechor:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 5:
Rachel shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim. afillu yatzu shene rashehen keechad i efshar shello kadam echad. hoil veen yadua e ze mehem yatza rishon hakkohen notel et hakkachush vehashsheni sefek bechor. met echad mehen en lakkohen kelum shezze hachay safek hu vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vechen im yalda zachar unekeva hare hazzachar safek shemma hannekeva yatzat techilla lefichach en lakkohen kelum shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
Shete rechelot shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim. shenehen lakkohen. zachar unekeva hazzachar lakkohen. shene zecharim unekeva hakkohen notel et hakkachush vehashsheni sefek bechor. veim met echad mehen en lakkohen kelum. shezze hazzachar hachay sefek bechor hu vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. yaldu shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot hare hazzecharim sefek bechor. sheani omer shemma hannekeva nolda techilla veachar kach hazzachar. lefichach en kan lakkohen kelum shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu lo shene zecharim. echad lo veechad lakkohen vechol echad mehen sefek bechor vehakkohen notel et hakkachush. met echad mehen en kan lakkohen kelum shezze hachay safek hu. vechen im yaldu zachar unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum shezze hazzachar sefek bechor hu:
Kol bechor shehu safek dino sheyyire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel livalav. veim tefaso hakkohen en motziin oto miyyado veochel oto bemumo. aval eno makrivo sheen makriv leolam ella bechor vadday shemma yishchot chullin baazara:
Mi shehaya beedro mevakkerot vesheenan mevakkerot veyaldu veen sham adam venichnas umatza et hamevakkerot menikot nekevot veet sheenan mevakkerot menikot zecharim. eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo uvenah shel zo ba lo etzel zo ella hare haddavar bechezkato shekkol achat menika benah:
Shenayim shehifkidu shene zecharim etzel haroe haechad bechor vehashsheni pashut umet echad mehen. manniach haroe hashsheni benehen umistallek vahare hu sefek bechor ushenehen cholkin oto sheen echad mehen makkir et shello:
Hifkid bechor etzel baal habbayit vehinnicho baal habbayit im pashut shello umet echad mehen veen yadua ezehu. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vahare hu sefek bechor. vaafillu roe kohen shehinniach bechoro bachatzar baal habbayit im pashut shel baal habbayit umet echad mehen hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veen motziin mechatzar baal habbayit ella biraya. shehare middaat baal habbechor hinnichu immo happashut shel baal habbayit:
Lo nechshedu yisrael al habbechorot lefichach neeman hayyisrael lomar ze sefek bechor hu veroin lo mumo veochel oto bemumo:
Kol hakkadashim shekkadam lahem mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bivchora. veim kadam mum over lehekdeshan o shehikdishan temimim veachar kach nolad lahem mum kavua venifdu peturin min habbechora. shehare lo yatzu lechullin lechol davar mippene shehen asurin begizza vaavoda kemo shebbearnu behilchot meila:
Hallokeach behema mimmeot maaser sheni birushalayim chayyevet bivchora. aval hallokeach behema mipperot sheviit hare zo petura min habbechora lefi sheeno rashshay laasot sechora beferot sheviit shehare neemar bah <small>(Vayikra 25 6)</small> "leachlah" leachlah velo lischora. veim tihye chayyevet bivchora hare ze mistakker bivchor shehare yatza mittorat perot sheviit. uchevar bearnu behilchot maachalot asurot sheasur laasot sechora bidvarim haasurim baachila vechen bearnu bitrumot sheasur laasot sechora bitrumot vechen asur laasot sechora bivchorot af al pi shemmuttar lemachran al derech shebbearnu: 
Lakach bechor lemishte beno o laregel velo tzarich lo muttar lemachro:
En shamin bechorot temimim leyisrael aval shamin lahen bechorot baale mumin. veshamin bechorot temimim lakkohanim bazzeman hazze shehen omdin leheachel bemuman. veen tzarich lomar sheshshamin lahen baale mumim:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 6: Mitzvat ase lehaferish echad measara mikkol behemot tehorot sheyyivvaldu laadam bechol shana veshana. veen mitzva zo noheget ella bevakar vetzon bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 32)</small> "vechol masar bakar vatzon" vegomer:

Maasar behema noheg bechullin aval lo bemukdashin. venoheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit. aval chachamim asru leasser behema bazzeman hazze vetikkenu sheen measserin ella bifne habbayit gezera shemma yochlehu tamim venimtza ba lide issur karet shehu shechitat kadashim bachutz. veim avar veasa bazzeman hazze hare ze maaser veyeachel bemumo:
Hakkol chayyavin bemaasar behema. kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim:

Vedin maasar behema sheyyihye nishchat baazara vezorkin et damo zerika achat keneged hayesod umaktirin emurav. ushear habbasar neechol labbealim birushalayim kishar kadashim kallim veen lakkohanim bo kelum ella kullo labbealim kappesach. veim haya baal mum ben shennafal bo mum ben shehifrisho battechilla bemumo hare ze neechol bechol makom:

Maasar behema asur lemachro keshehu tamim shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "lo yiggael". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar lo yiggael af issur mechira bemashma sheen nigal veeno nimkar kelal. veyerae li shehammocher maaser lo asa kelum velo kana lokeach. ulefichach eno loke kemocher cherme kohanim shello kana lokeach uchemocher yefat toar kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Middivre sofrim sheasur lemachro baal mum vaafillu shachut gezera shemma yimkerennu chay. lefichach en shoklin mana keneged mana bemaaser kederech sheshshoklin bivchor. mippene shehu nire kemocher:
Umaasar behema shel yetomim shennishchat bemumo muttar lemachro kedarko. mippene hashavat aveda litomim lo gazru alav:

Maasar behema shennishchat bemumo muttar limkor chelbo vegidav veoro veatzmotav. velo asru limkor ella besaro bilvad. veim hivlia deme habbasar bidme haor vehachelev vehaggidin umachar hakkol behavelaa muttar. veim hayu deme haatzamot yekarim vehivlia deme habbasar bidme haatzamot muttar:

Hakkol neemanim al mume maaser lomar mum ze meelav ba velo naasa ledaat. vaafillu ellu sheenan neemanim al habbechor neemanim al hammaaser. veroe adam mume maaser shello umattiro im haya mumche. sheim yirtze yattil mum bechol edro veachar kach yeasser venimtza hammaaser baal mum mittechillato:

Hallokeach telaim shennoldu beshana zo o shennittenu lo bemattana hare hem peturim min hammaaser ad sheyyivvaldu birshuto. lefichach hashshuttafin shennishtattefu bivhemot vehevi ze mea telaim veze mea telaim veervum venishtattefu bahen hare hammatayim peturim min hammaaser shekkol tale mehen kemachur. vechen haachim sheyyarshu telaim meavihem hare hen peturin min hammaaser. aval hannoladim lahem beshuttafut leachar mikkan meellu habbehemot ben lashshuttafin ben laachim chayyavin bemaaser. vechen im hayu shuttafin bemaot vekanu behemot mimmeot hashshuttafut vehaachim shekkanu behemot mimmeot hayerushsha hare hannoladim mehem leachar mikkan chayyavin bemaaser shehare birshutan noldu vahare hen keish echad. chalku haachim vehashshuttafin achar shennoldu lahen habbehemot birshutan vechazru venishtattefu hare ellu peturin min hammaaser. shebbeshaa shechalku naasu hakkol lekuchin vehallakuach patur ucheshechazru venishtattefu hare nishtattefu babbehemot vaadayin lo yaldu lahen birshutan achar shittuf ze hashsheni. veaf al pi shechalku gedayim keneged gedayim utelaim keneged telaim vaasara keneged asara hakkol peturin min hammaaser vahare hen kilkuchin:

Haachin vehashshuttafin shechalku bichsafim velo chalku bivhema chayyavin bemaaser sheadayin lo naasu habbehemot lekuchin. aval im chalku habbehemot af al pi sheadayin lo chalku hakkesafim hare ellu peturin:
Hallokeach asara ubbarim bime imman. kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser shehare birshuto noldu:
Kohen shennaflu lo eser behemot begezel hagger peturim min hammaaser. shemmattenot kehunna mattanot hem. uchevar bearnu shehannoten mattana patur min hammaaser:

Hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser. ben temimim ben baale mumin. vechol issure mizbeach. chutz min hakkilayim. vehatterefa. veyotze dofen. umechussar zeman. shekkol ellu peturin min hammaaser. vechen hayyatom shemmeta immo o nishchata im ledato eno mitasser. udevarim ellu mippi hashshemua hem:

En hallokeach patur ella im ken nilkach achar shennira lehitasser. lefichach hallokeach telaim betoch shivat yeme halleda kesheyyaggia zemannam chayyav leasseran. shekkevan sheen mechussar zeman rauy lehitasser hare ze kemi shellakach ubbarim venoldu birshuto:

Kol behema shehi safek im bat maaser hi o enah bat maaser. hare hi petura min hammaaser. lefichach telaim shennitarev bahen yatom o lakuach vechayyotze bahen hare kullan peturin min hammaaser. shekkol echad mehen safek hu:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 7:
Mi shehayu lo asara telaim vehifrish echad measara. hayu lo mea vehifrish asara lemaaser. en ellu maaser. ella ketzad ose. kones kol hattelaim o kol haagalim laddir. veose lo petach katan kede shello yetzu shenayim keechad. veimmotehen maamid mibbachutz. vehen goot sheyyishmeu hattelaim kolan veyetzu min haddir likratan. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 32)</small> "kl asher yaavor tachat hashshavet". sheyyaavor meatzmo velo sheyyotzio beyado. uchesheyyetzu min haddir ze achar ze. matchil umone otan bashshevet. 1 2 3 4 Adonai 6 7 8 9. vehayyotze asiri ben zachar ben nekeva ben tamim ben baal mum sokro besikra veomer hare ze maaser. lo sekaro besikra velo menaan bashshevet o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim hare ellu maaser hoil umenaam asara asara vekiddesh asiri hare ze maaser:
En tzarich letzaref kol behema shennolda birshuto ledir echad ella metzaref kol eder veeder levaddo. hayu lo chamishsha telaim birushalayim vachamishsha telaim beakko en mitztarfin vechullan peturin min hammaaser. vechamma yihye ben ellu leellu veyitztarfu shishsha asar mil:
Hayu shelosha adarim ben kol echad veechad shishsha asar mil hare shelashtan mitztarfin. ketzad. haya tisha mikkan vetisha mikkan veechad beemtza hare shelashtan nichnasin laddir lehitasser:
En measserin min hatztzon al habbakar velo min habbakar al hatztzon. aval measserin min hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 32)</small> "vechol masar bakar vatzon" mashma kol tzon echad sheshshenehem nikraim se vahare hem kemin echad:
En measserim min hannoladim beshana zo al hannoladim beshana acheret keshem sheen measserin bezera haaretz min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "hayyotze hassade shana shana". veyerae li sheim isser behema mishshana al shana hare ze maaser mippene chumrat hakodashim shehare lo hikpida tora al maasar behema beferush sheyyihye shana shana:
Kol hannoladim beechad betishre ad esrim vetisha beelul mitztarfin umeasserin meellu al ellu. noldu chamishsha telaim beesrim vetisha beelul vachamishsha beechad betishre en mitztarfin. yaldu toladot betoch shenatan hare hi uvittah nichnasim laddir lehitasser:
En hattelaim hannoladim kemo hattevel sheasur leechol mimmennu ad sheyyeasser kemo shebbearnu bimkomo ella muttar limkor velishchot kol ma sheyyirtze ad sheyyeasser veyihye hammaaser kodesh veyeachel kehilchato kemo shebbearnu:
Kavu chachamim shelosha zemannim beshana lemaasar behema umishsheyaggia zeman mehen asur lo limkor o lishchot ad sheyyeasser veim shachat hare ze muttar. veellu hen hashshelosha zemannim. beyom chamishsha asar kodem happesach uvayyom chamishsha asar kodem atzeret uvayyom chamishsha asar kodem hechag. vechol zeman meellu nikra goren maasar behema. nimtzeta omer shehaggoranot shel maasar behema beyom acharon mechodesh adar uvayyom sheloshim vachamishsha missefirat haomer uveyom acharon mechodesh elul. velamma kavu haggoranot bayamim ellu kede shettihyena habbehemot metzuyot leole regalim. sheaf al pi shemmuttar limkor kodem sheyyeasser kemo shebbearnu hayu nimnaim limkor ad sheyyeasseru veyaasu hammitzva:
Hichnis kol hatztzon o habbakar laddir vehitchil limnot ulekaddesh asiri ad shennisharu betoch haddir pachot measara hare ze mannichan legoren acher vehen mitztarfin leellu sheyyivvaldu veyitasseru hakkol begoren echad. veaf al pi shehu yodea sheellu yishshaaru bamminyan chayyav lehachenis hakkol laddir vehannishar yishshaer:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 8:
Hammachnnis tzon laddir vehitchilu latzet achat achat vehu mone kemo shebbearnu vetaa bamminyan vekara lashshemini o leshellematta mimmennu asiri o shekkara lashshenem asar o shellemala mimmennu asiri lo nitkaddeshu. aval im kara latteshii o laachad asar asiri nitkaddeshu. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala nishma shehattaut mitkaddeshot lemaaser shellemala mimmennu veshellematta mimmennu aval lo shellifnehem veshelleacharehem. afillu kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri ben betaut ben bechavvana shelashtan mukdashim:
Veheach dinam. hatteshii eno karev ella neechol bemumo. vehaasiri maaser. vehaachad asar yikkarev shelamim vetaun nesachim kishlamim veeno ose temura mippene shehu atzmo kitmura. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammone hu baal habbehemot aval haose shaliach leasser lo vetaa ben batteshii ben baachad asar en mekaddesh ella haasiri havvadday bilvad. shello asaahu shaliach litot ulehafsid ella lekaddesh karauy:
Ze sheamarnu sheim kara laachad asar asiri nitkaddesh keshekkara laasiri teshii aval im kara laasiri asiri vekara acharav laachad asar asiri lo nitkaddesh achad asar shehare haasiri havvadday lo akar shem asiri mealav. vaafillu yatza haasiri velo keraahu lo asiri velo achad asar ella shatak veachar kach yatza achad asar ukeraahu asiri lo nitkaddesh shehaasiri meatzmo nitkaddesh. veaf al pi shello keraahu asiri hoil velo akar shem asiri mealav en achad asar mekuddash:
Yatzu teshii vaasiri keechad ben shekkara shenehem asiri. ben shekkeraam teshii. shenehem mukdashin veyeachlu bemuman veenan kerevin. vechen im yatza asiri veachad asar keechad. im keraan asiri hare asiri veachad asar meoravim ze baze vehem kemo maaser shennitarev bishlamim sheyyeachlu bemuman kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin. veim keraan achad asar hare haasiri vehachullin meoravin ze baze veyeachlu bemuman:
Hitchil limnot veyatzu techilla shenayim shehen rishon vesheni hare ze mone hakkol zug zug umekaddesh zug asiri. vechen im menaan shelosha shelosha bechol paam ufaam o chamishsha chamishsha mekaddesh hakkat haasirit:
Yatzu battechilla shenayim umenaan echad vekara hashshelishi sheyyatza acharehen sheni umana kedarko echad echad hare hatteshii vehaasiri mukdashin veyeachlu bemuman. hatteshii mippene shehu haasiri havvadday shehare shenayim yatzu battechilla. veze shekkerao asiri hu achad asar vehakkore leachad asar asiri nitkaddesh kemo shebbearnu:
Menaan lemafrea kegon sheyyatza rishon veamar asiri veyatza sheni veamar teshii ad sheyyatza haasiri umana achat hare ze kadash shehaasiri meelav nitkaddesh:
Kara latteshii asiri venishar haasiri baddir. hatteshii yeachel bemumo veze shennishar baddir maaser af al pi shello yatza velo berro shehaasiri meelav nitkaddesh. met haasiri baddir hatteshii yeachel bemumo vechol hashshemona sheyyatzu venimnu peturin veaf al pi shello nitkaddesh asiri shellahen likkarev ella met kodem sheyyatza. shehamminyan harauy poter:
Hichnis asara telaim laddir vehaya mone veholech. met echad min hammenuyin mone umashlim kedarko umekaddesh asiri af al pi sheen sham atta chayyim ella tisha:
Met echad meellu shebbetoch haddir ellu shennimnu peturin mippene shehamminyan harauy lemaaser poter af al pi shello hifrish alehen kemo shebbearnu. veellu shebbetoch haddir mannichan legoren acher ad sheyyitztarfu laacherim. vechen mi shehayu lo arbaa asar telaim vehichnisan laddir veyatzu arbaa umenaan befetach ze veyatzu shishsha umenaan befetach acher venisharu sham arbaa betoch haddir. im yatzu haarbaa hannisharim min happetach sheyyatzu bo hashshishsha notel mehen echad vechullan peturin. sheotan haarbaa sheyyatzu techilla mippetach rishon minyan harauy petaran. veim yatzu ellu haarbaa hannisharim min happetach sheyyatzu bo haarbaa techilla. hare otam haarbaa sheyyatzu battechilla veotan hashshishsha sheyyatzu acharehen befetach sheni peturin shekkol echad mehen nimne minyan harauy lemaaser shehare nisharu sham baddir acherim lehashelim hamminyan uleasser. aval ellu haarbaa shennisharu af al pi sheyyatzu venimnu mippetach harishon eno minyan harauy lefichach mitztarfin legoren acher. yatzu arbaa mippetach ze vearbaa mippetach sheni venisharu sham shishsha. im yatzu hashshishsha meechad mishshene happetachim notel mehen echad maaser vechullan peturin. veim yatzu hashshishsha bishne happetachim hare hashshishsha mitztarfin legoren acher vehashshemona sheyyatzu techilla mikkan umikkan peturin shekkol arbaa mehen nimnu minyan harauy lehashelim alav asara uleasser shehare shishsha hayu sham nisharim betoch haddir:
Hayu lo tisha asar telaim betoch haddir veyatzu tisha befetach ze vetisha befetach sheni notel haacharon leshem maaser vechullan peturin. sheotan hattisha nimnu minyan harauy:
Haya mone vehotzi hattale rosho verubbo min haddir vechazar hare hu kemanuy lechol davar:
Haya mone vehifsik hamminyan mippene chavero sheddibber immo o shechashcha lel shabbat hare ze chozer umashlim minyano achar kach:
Haya mone hayyotzin echad echad umekaddesh asiri vekafatz echad min hammenuyin letoch haddir letoch ellu sheadayin lo nimnu velo nitasseru. nifteru hakkol. shekkol echad mehen safek im hu hammanuy shekkafatz o acher. uchevar bearnu shekkol hammenuyin peturin:
Kafatz echad min haasiriyyim letoch haddir. kullan yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyeachlu bemuman:
Mishneh Torah, Offerings for Unintention: Kol haover bishgaga al achat mimmitzvot lo taase sheyyesh bah maase shechayyavin aleha karet. hare ze chayyav lehakeriv karban chattat. umitzvat ase sheyyakriv chattato al shiggato:

Vechol avera shechayyavin al zedonah karet chayyavin al shiggatah chattat chutz mishshalosh averot. megaddef. umevattel mila. vekarban pesach. happesach vehammila mippene shehen mitzvat ase vechattat en meviin ella al shiggat lo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 13)</small> "achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena". vehamegaddef mippene sheen bo maase veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 29)</small> "laose bishgaga" yatza megaddef sheen bo maase. lefichach hamekabbel avoda zara beloah af al pi shehu chayyav karet im haya mezid niskal veim kibbel bishgaga patur min hakkarban lefi shello asa maase veneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 27)</small> "baasotah achat":

Kol keretot shebbattora chutz mishshalosh keretot shebbearnu im avar hayyachid al achat mehen bishgaga mevi chattat kevua chutz mittame sheachal kodesh vetame shennichnas lammikdash sheshshenehem en meviin chattat kevua ella karban ole veyored kemo sheyyitbaer:

Chattat kevua hi habbaa min habbehema bilvad vekarban ole veyored hu karban sheeno kavua ella im haya ashir mevi chattat behema veim haya ani mevi of o asirit haefa kemo sheyyitbaer. nimtzeta lamed shekkol haaverot shehayyachid mevi al shiggatan chattat kevua arbaim veshalosh. veellu hen: 1) habba al immo. 2) habba al em ishto. 3) habba al em immah. 4) habba al em aviha. 5) habba al bitto. 6) habba al bat bitto. 7) habba al bat beno. 8) habba al bat ishto. 9) habba al bat bittah. 10) habba al bat benah. 11) habba al achoto. 12) habba al achoto shehi bat eshet aviv. 13) habba al achot aviv. yad) habba al achot immo. 15) habba al achot ishto. 16) habba al eshet aviv. 17) habba al eshet achi aviv. 18) habba al eshet beno. 19) habba al eshet achiv. 20) habba al eshet ish. ka) habba al hannidda. 22) hashshochev im zachar. 23) habba al aviv. kad) habba al achi aviv. ko) hashshochev im behema. 26) haishsha shemmeviah aleha et habbehema. nimtzeu kol keretot shebbaarayot esrim veshesh. uvishar haaverot sheva esre. veellu hen: 1) haoved avoda zara bemaase. 2) hannoten mizzaro lammolech. 3) baal ov. 4) baal yiddeoni bemaase. 5) hamechallel et hashshabbat. 6) haose melacha beyom hakkippurim. 7) haochel veshote beyom hakkippurim. 8) haochel notar. 9) haochel chametz befesach. 10) haochel chelev. 11) haochel dam. 12) haochel piggul. 13) hashshochet kadashim chutz laazara. yad) hammaale karban chutz laazara. 15) hamefattem et shemen hammishcha. 16) hamefattem et hakketoret. 17) hassach beshemen hammishcha. hare ellu arbaim veshalosh averot shemmeviin al shiggatan chattat kevua. uma hu hakkarban shemmevi hashshogeg beachat meellu. im shagag baavoda zara mevi ez bat shenatah lechattat vehi haamura befarashat shelach lecha ben shehaya hachote hedyot o melech o kohen gadol o meshuach milchama hakkol shavin beshiggat avoda zara. aval im shagag beachat mishshear arbaim ushetayim im haya hedyot mevi seirat izzim o nekeva min hakkevasim vezo hi chattat shel echad meam haaretz haamura befarashat vayyikra. veim hammelech hu sheshshagag beachat mehen mevi seirat izzim lechattat. veim kohen mashuach hu mevi par ben bakar lechattat vehu nisraf kemo shennitparesh sham:

Echad yachid sheshshagag beachat meellu o merubbin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 29)</small> "tora achat tihye lachem laosho bishgaga". ketzad. anshe medina sheshshaggu vedimmu shehayyom chol vahare hu yom hakkippurim vechullan achlu veasu melacha. kol echad mehen mevi shete chattaot kevasot o seirot. vechen im shaggu kullan vehiktiru laavoda zara kol echad veechad min haovdim mevi ez bat shenatah lechattat:

En adam chayyav chattat al shiggato ad sheyyihye shogeg mittechilla vead sof aval im shagag battechilla vehezid bassof o hezid battechilla veshagag bassof patur mikkarban chattat. ketzad. kegon shehotzi chefetz mershut lirshut beshabbat akar bezadon vehinniach bishgaga o sheakar bishgaga vehinniach bezadon patur ad sheyyaakor bishgaga veyanniach bishgaga. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Avar avera veyodea shehi belo taase aval eno yodea shechayyavin aleha karet hare zo shegaga umevi chattat. aval im yada shehi becharet veshagag bekarban velo yada im chayyavin aleha karban im lav hare ze mezid. sheshshiggat karban enah shegaga baaverot ellu shechayyavin alehen karet:

Mi shello noda lo atzmo shel chet shechata. af al pi sheyyada bevadday sheavar al lo taase sheyyesh bo karet. hare ze patur mikkarban chattat. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 23)</small> "asher chata bah" ad sheyyeda hachet shechata bo. ketzad. chelev venotar lefanav veachal et echad mehem veen yadua e ze achal. ishto nidda vaachoto babbayit veshagag uva al achat mehen veen yadua e zo mehen baal. shabbat veyom hakkippurim lefanav veasa melacha beechad mehen veen yadua bee ze mehen asa hare ze patur mikkarban chattat:
Chata venoda lo chattato vechazar ushechacho hare ze mevi chattat leshem ma shehu veteachel kishar chattaot hanneechalot:

Shagag beshem echad vehem shene gufin chayyav. ketzad. shete niddot veshagag beachat mehen veen yadua e zo hi. shete achayot veshagag beachat mehen veen yadua e zo hi chayyav chattat shehare yada atzmo shel chet. lema ze dome lishte nerot dolkot shekkibba achat mehen veen yadua e zo ner hi. o lishne tamchuyin shel chelev sheachal meechad mehen veen yadua mee ze tamchuy mehen achal shehu chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol hamechuyyav chattat kevua al shiggato veasa bishgaga venoda lo achar shechata af al pi shello hayta lo yedia battechilla shezze chet hu hare ze chayyav chattat. ketzad. tinok shennishba leven haakkum vegadal vehu eno yodea ma hem yisrael velo datam veasa melacha beshabbat veachal chelev vedam vechayyotze bahen. kesheyyivvada lo shehu yisrael vmtzuvve al kol ellu chayyav lehavi chattat al kol avera vaavera. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hashshogeg belo kavvana baarayot o bemaachalot asurot chayyav chattat. beshabbat patur mechattat. ketzad. haya mitassek im ishsha uvealah belo kavvana livila vahare hi erva alav. dimma shezze shebbefiv rok hu uvelao belo kavvana leshem achila baolam vahare hu chelev hare ze chayyav chattat. nitkavvin lehagebiah et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar belo kavvana lachatichato patur. melechet machashevet asra tora kemo shebbearnu bimkomo:

Kol haose mitzva min hammitzvot uvichlal asiyyatah naaset avera shechayyavin aleha karet bishgaga hare ze patur mechattat mippene sheasa birshut. ketzad. habba al yevimto vahare hi nidda vehu lo yada. hare ze patur mechattat shehare asaah birshut. aval im ba al ishto vahare hi nidda chayyav chattat mippene shello shealah veachar kach yivol. aval yevimto eno ragil bah kede sheyyishal lah. vechen mi shehayu lo shene tinokot echad lamul beshabbat veechad lamul beerev shabbat o beechad beshabbat veshachach umal shenehen beshabbat. patur mechattat shehare yesh lo reshut lamul echad mehen beshabbat veshabbat dechuya hi etzlo umitzva asa af al pi shehem shene gufin hoil uzemanno bahul eno medakdek. aval im lo haya echad mehen rauy lamul beshabbat veshachach umal beshabbat mi sheeno rauy lamul beshabbat chayyav chattat:

Umman shebba lamul lifnot hayyom beyom hashshabbat veamru lo lo nishar penay bayyom kede shettamul veim tatchil lamul lo tashlim ad yetziat hashshabbat venimtzeta chovel beshabbat velo ose mitzva. veamar ragil ani vezariz uvimhera amul. im lo hishlim ella ad yetziat hashshabbat hare ze chayyav chattat shehare hitru bo:

Hammotzi et hallulav beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat kede letzet bo veheeviro arba ammot birshut harabbim beshogeg patur shehare birshut hotzi. vechen hashshochet et happesach beyom arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat venoda lo achar ken shemmashchu habbealim et yedehem o shemmetu o nitmeu kodem shechita. o shennimtza terefa basseter kegon nekuv meayim o rea. hare ze patur mippene sheshshachat birshut. aval nimtza baal mum o shehayta terefa geluya hare ze chayyav chattat mippene shehaya lo livdok veachar kach yishchot. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Shachat et happesach beshabbat shello lishmo betaut patur mippene shehazzevach kasher sheakirat shemo betaut eno akira kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin:

Shachat zevachim acherim leshem pesach betaut. im reuyin hem lekarban pesach patur mikkarban chattat mippene sheshshachat birshut. im enan reuyin kegon shehayta nekeva o ben shetayim chayyav chattat shehare eno rauy lekarban pesach. vechen im shagag ushechato beshabbat shello leochlav o shello limnuyav o laarelim o litmeim chayyav chattat. shechato leochlav veshello leochlav limnuyav veshello limnuyav lemulim velaarelim litmeim velithorim patur. shehare happesach kasher. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Hashshochet beshabbat karban tzibbur shello lishmo hare ze chayyav chattat veyaktir emurim laerev. vechen im shachat yeter al chovat hayyom chayyav chattat al hattosefet:

Shachat karbenot yachid sheen dochim et hashshabbat beshabbat bishgaga chayyav chattat vehabbasar muttar bahanaa. veen zorkin et haddam. veim avar vezarak damam lishman ben beshogeg ben bemezid alu labbealim leshem chova. veyaktir emurin laerev vehabbasar yeachel veyavi hashshochet chattat al shiggato:

Hayu lefanav shete behemot shel tzibbur achat kechusha veachat shemena vehayta chovat hayyom beachat ben chattat ben ola veshagag veshachat hashshetayim. im shachat kechusha battechilla veachar kach shachat hashshemena patur mikkarban chattat velo od ella sheomrim lo have shemena ushechot lechattechilla. aval im shachat hashshemena techilla veachar kach hakkechusha chayyav chattat al hattosefet. nimtzet harishona hashshemena terefa bivne meayim af al pi shello yada shehi terefa beet sheshshachat hakkechusha velo laze nitkavven hoil venishchata haacharona kemitzvatah hare ze patur mechattat. vechen happores metzuda lehaalot dagim min hayyam bishgaga veheela tinok im haddagim ben sheshshama shettava tinok ben shello shama hoil veheela tinok hare ze patur mechattat af al pi shello hayta kavvanato ella latzud mippene shehaya shogeg. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehaya lefanav belele happesach tzali shel pesach venotar min hakkadashim venitkavven leechol tzali shehu mitzva veshagag veachal hannotar hare ze chayyav chattat shehare lo asa mitzva baachila zo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi sheheidu alav edim shechata chet shechayyavin alav chattat kevua velo hitru bo ella amru reinucha sheasita melacha beshabbat o sheachalta chelev vehu omer ani yodea bevadday shello asiti davar ze. eno chayyav chattat hoil veim yomar mezid hayiti yippater min hakkarban kesheamar lahen lo achalti velo asiti naasa keomer lo achalti bishgaga ella bezadon shehu patur min hakkarban velo hichchish et haedim:
Shatak velo hiflig et haedim (ella) afillu amra lo ishsha achalta chelev o asita melacha beshabbat veshatak chayyav lehavi chattat. amar lo ed echad chelev hu ze veshatak. vechazar vaachalo bishgaga mevi chattat. veim hitru bo loke alav. af al pi sheikkar haedut beed echad:
Kevar bearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin shehammafrish chattato al hachelev sheachal lo yevienna al hashshabbat shechillel o al haddam sheachal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 28)</small> "vehevi karbano seirat izzim" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 4 28)</small> "al chattato asher chata" ad sheyyihye karbano leshem cheto lo sheyyakrivenna mechet al chet. veim hikriv pesalah. yeter al ze amru hifrish chattato al chelev sheachal emesh lo yevienna al chelev sheachal hayyom veim hevi kipper. veen tzarich lomar sheim hifrishah aviv umet vehaya habben mechuyyav beoto hachet shello yevienna habben al cheto kemo shennitbaer sham:
Hammevi chattat al shene chataim tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bidme chetzyah lechet ze uvidme chetzyah lachet hashsheni. vechen shenayim sheheviu chattat achat al shene chataehem tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi ze chattato bidme chetzyah veyavi ze chattato bidme chetzyah:
Hevi shete chattaot al chet echad yakriv e zo sheyyirtze vehashsheniyya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava:
Hevi shete chattaot al shene chataim zo tishshachet leshem chet haechad vehashsheniyya leshem hachet hashsheni:
Kevar bearnu behilchot maase hakkarbanot shehammumar laavoda zara o lechallel shabbatot befarhesya en mekabbelin mimmennu karban kelal. vehammumar laavera mishshear averot en mekabbelin mimmennu chattat al oto hachet. ketzad. mumar leechol chelev sheachal chelev bishgaga vehevi chattato en mekabbelin mimmennu ad sheyyachazor bitshuva. afillu haya mumar leechol chelev leteavon venitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo vehevi karban en mekabbelin mimmennu. shemmishsheachal bezadon ben lehacheis ben leteavon hare hu mumar. haya mumar leechol chelev veshagag veachal dam mekabbelin mimmennu kemo shebbearnu:
Mi sheshshagag vehifrish chattato veachar kach naasa mumar vechazar bitshuva o nishtatta vechazar venishtappa. af al pi shennidcha hakkarban bentayim hare ze chazar venira sheen baale chayyim nidchin kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin lefichach yakrivenna atzmah. ucheshem sheim nolad bo mum over venitrappe yachzor lechashruto kach im niddechu habbealim vechazru veniru yikkarev:
Chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddaim sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim. vechayyave ashamot teluyin peturin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "mikkl chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". kach lamdu mippi hashshemua shekkol chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai nitkapper lo. lefichach mi shebba al yado sefek avera beyom hakkippurim afillu im chashecha patur measham taluy shekkol hayyom mechapper. nimtzeta lamed sheen meviin al lo hoda shel yom hakkippurim asham taluy ella im lo kipper lo yom hakkippurim kemo sheyyitbaer:
En yom hakkippurim velo hachattat velo haasham mechapperin ella al hashshavim hammaaminim bechapparatan. aval hamevaet bahen enan mechapperin bo. ketzad. haya mevaet vehevi chattato o ashamo vehu omer o mechashshev belibbo sheen ellu mechapperin. af al pi shekkarvu kemitzvatan lo nitkapper lo uchesheyyachazor bitshuva mibbeitato tzarich lehavi chattato vaashamo. vechen hamevaet beyom hakkippurim en yom hakkippurim mechapper alav. lefichach im nitchayyev beasham taluy veavar alav yom hakkippurim vehu mevaet bo hare ze lo nitkapper lo uchesheyyachazor bitshuva achar yom hakkippurim chayyav lehavi kol asham taluy shehaya chayyav bo:
Kol ashamot shebbattora meakkevin et hakkappara chutz measham nazir. sefek nazir usefek mechussere kefara usefek sota kullam meviin karbenotehen achar yom hakkippurim:
Mi shehu mechuyyav chattat o asham vahare hu yotze mibbet din lehareg im haya zivcho zavuach mashhin oto ad sheyyizzarek haddam veachar kach yehareg. veim adayin lo nishchat hazzevach en mashhin oto ad sheyyakrivu alav:

Haose averot harebe behelem achat chayyav chattat al kol achat veachat afillu asa haarbaim veshalosh ellu shemmaninu behelem achat chayyav arbaim veshalosh chattaot. vechen im asa maase echad shehu chayyav alav mishshum shemot harebe chayyav al kol shem veshem vehu shehayu haissurin kullan bain keachat o issur mosif o issur kolel. ketzad. hashshochet behemat kadashim chutz laazara beshabbat laavoda zara chayyav shalosh chattaot. mishshum shochet kadashim bachutz umishshum mechallel shabbat umishshum oved avoda zara shehare sheloshet haissurin bain keachat. bamme devarim amurim beomer bigmar zevicha hu oved otah. aval im lo hayta kavvanato lechach mishsheyyishchot bah meat leshem avoda zara teaser veeno chayyav mishshum shechute chutz ad sheyyishchot shenayim o rov shenayim. venimtza kesheggamar hashshechita shachat behema haasura lekarban sheeno chayyav aleha mishshum shochet bachutz kemo shebbearnu. hayta chattat haof vehaya chatzi kane shellah pagum vehosif bo kol shehu beshabbat leshem avoda zara chayyav shalosh chattaot shehare sheloshet haissurin baim keachat. vechen haose melacha beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat chayyav shete chattaot mippene sheshshene haissurin bain keachat. habba al eshet achiv hakkayyam keshehi nidda mevi shalosh chattaot mishshum eshet ish umishshum eshet ach vehen shene issurin habbain keachat umishshum nidda shehu issur mosif shemmittoch shennitvassef bah issur ze levalah nosaf livamah. vechen kayyotze baze. habba al aviv chayyav shetayim achat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 18 7)</small> "ervat avicha lo tegalle" umishshum <small>(Vayikra 18 22)</small> "veet zachar lo tishkav". vechen habba al achi aviv chayyav shetayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 14)</small> "ervat achi avicha lo tegalle". habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav behelem achat af al pi shehen shene gufin eno chayyav ella chattat achat shenneemar veet zachar lo tishkav hashshochev vehannishkav shem echad hu. vechen habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav behelem achat eno chayyav ella chattat achat. asu hashshochev vehannishkav bivhema vezachur kivila achat: 
Yesh boel beila achat vechayyav aleha shemone chattaot. ketzad. yaakov shehayta lo bat mizzilpa ushemah timna. nasa lavan timna veholid mimmenna bat ushemah serach. veen lelavan bat ella rachel levaddah. nimtzet serach bat bat yaakov vaachot ishto meaviha hen shene issurin habbain keachat. nisset serach liruven veneesra al shear bene yaakov nosaf bah issur leyaakov vahare hi kallato. met reuven o geresh venisset serach zo laachi yaakov meimmo mittoch shenneesra al shear ache yaakov nosaf leyaakov bah issur eshet achiv. met o geresh venisset serach zo leyishmael mittoch shenneesra al shear ache yishmael nosaf leyaakov bah issur eshet achi aviv. met yishmael venafla leyibbum lifne yitzchak veavar yitzchak veyibbemah af al pi shehi sheniyya lo mittoch shenneesra al shear echav nosaf bah issur leyaakov mishshum eshet aviv umishshum eshet ish sheshshene haissurin bain keachat. im shagag yaakov uva al serach zo keshehi nidda bechayye yitzchak balah uvechayye rachel eshet yaakov hare ze chayyav aleha shemone chattaot. mishshum bat bitto. umishshum achot ishto. umishshum kallato. umishshum eshet achiv. umishshum eshet achi aviv. umishshum eshet aviv. umishshum eshet ish. umishshum nidda. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Kol ellu shetteaser zo haerva alehen beissur mosif. tzarich sheyyehu haanashim haacherim metzuyin baolam kede shetteaser alehen umittoch shetteaser alehen yitvassef issur acher laze. aval im enan metzuyin en omrin hoil illu haya laze banim o achim hayta neesra alehen yitvassef bah issur lazzaken. shehare en sham atta lo ben velo ach. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:
Mi shehaya nasuy shalosh nashim. uva al immah shel achat mehen shehi em immah shel sheniyya shehi em aviha shel shelishit. af al pi shezzekena zo hi chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv ushelosha shemot hen veissur bat achat hi eno chayyav ella chattat achat lefi shenneemar beishsha uvittah uvat benah uvat bittah <small>(Vayikra 18 17)</small> "shaara henna zimma hi". hakkatuv asa shelosha gufin keguf echad lefichach yechashvu hashshelosha shemot keshem echad:
Aval habba al achoto shehi achot aviv vehi achot immo chayyav shalosh chattaot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 17)</small> "ervat achoto gilla". chayyav al achoto bifne atzmah veaf al pi shehi achot immo vaachot aviv. veheach tihye zot kegon shebba al immo veholid mimmenna shete banot uvaal achat mibbenotav veholid mimmenna ben. kesheyyavo hammamzer hazze al habbat hashshenit. shehi achot immo hammamzeret. shehi achoto meaviv. shehi achot aviv meimmo. chayyav shalosh chattaot. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hava al erva biot harebe behelem achat. af al pi shehaya ben beila uveila yamim harebe. hoil velo noda lo bentayim vahare hi guf echad. hare hakkol shegaga achat veeno chayyav ella chattat achat. aval im shagag bah veachar kach noda lo vechazar veshagag bah atzmah uvealah. veachar kach noda lo vechazar veshagag bah atzmah uvealah. chayyav al kol beila uveila. shehayediot mechallekot hashshegagot:
Habba al haerva biot harebe behelem achat. vezo hannivelet hayta lah yedia ben kol bia uvia. shennimtzeu habbiot etzlah behaalamot harebe. hu mevi chattat achat. vehi mevia chattat al kol bia uvia. hu hayu lo yediot bentayim vehi behelem achat. hu mevi chattaot harebe vehi mevia chattat achat:
Habba al arayot harebe behelem achat. af al pi shekkullan mishshem echad hoil vehen gufim muchlakim chayyav al kol achat veachat. ketzad. hare shebbaal chamesh nashav niddot. o shebba al chamesh achyotav o al chamesh benotav behelem achat. chayyav al kol guf veguf. mikkan atta lamed shezze sheamru chachamim habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav behelem achat chayyav chattat achat. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya oto hazzachur atzmo. aval im haya zachur acher. ben shebba al shenayim ben shebba al ze vehevi ze alav chayyav al kol guf veguf. vehu haddin beva al habbehema vehevi behema alav:
Haishsha shehevia aleha behemot harebe behelem achat chayyevet chattat al kol behema uvehema. shehare gufin muchlakin vahare zo kemi shennivala laanashim harebe behelem echad shehi chayyevet chattat al kol ish veish:
Haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam veshama shemmet o shebbau edim shemmet venisset ben al pi atzmah ben al pi bet din. venoda shebbalah kayyam. chayyevet karban echad. veim nisset laanashim harebe o shezzinneta im anashim harebe. chayyevet chattat al kol ish veish mippene shehen gufim muchlakin veaf al pi shehakkol bishgaga achat. habba al hannidda bishgaga vetahara minniddatah vetavla vechazra veraata nidda uva aleha paam sheniyya beotah shegaga atzmah. chayyav al kol paam ufaam. af al pi shehu behelem achat vehu guf echad. shezzeman niddut ze chutz mizzeman niddut hashshenit. vahare hen kishte nashim niddot:
Habba al ishto shello bishat vestah veraata dam bishat hattashmish. hare ellu peturin mikkarban chattat mippene shezze keanus hu velo shogeg. shehashshogeg haya lo livdok uledakdek veillu badak yafe yafe vedikdek bishelot lo haya ba lide shegaga ulefi shello tarach bidrisha uvachakira veachar kach yaase tzarich kappara. aval ze ma lo laasot hare tehora hayta veshello bishat vestah baal en ze ella ones. ulefichach ben shennimtza dam al ed shellah ben shennimtza al ed shello peturin. aval im avar uva aleha samuch lavveset vedimma sheyyivol veyifrosh kodem shettire dam veraata bishat hattashmish. chayyavin bekarban. shezzo hi shegaga. lefichach im nimtza dam al ed shello shenehem temeim vechayyavin bekarban. nimtza al ed shellah. im kinnecha atzmah miyyad keshepperash habbaal velo shahata shenehem temeim vechayyavin bekarban. vim shahata kede shettoshit yadah letachat hakkar o letachat hakkeset vetittol ed livdok bo veachar kach kinnecha atzmah shenehen temeim besafek ufeturin mikkarban. veim shahata kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha veachar kach kinnecha atzmah venimtza dam. balah tahor:
Mi sheavar uvaal samuch lavveset al daat shettikdom biato liriyyat haddam vehirgisha haishsha shennitmet bishat tashmish veamra lo nitmeti. hare ze lo yifrosh keshehu mitkashshe kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure bia. veim lo yada sheasur lifrosh miyyad uferash keshehu mitkashshe chayyav shete chattaot. achat al kenisato shehare baal nidda veachat al yetziato sheyyetziato hanaa lo keviato. bamme devarim amurim kesheyyada sheasur livol bishat havveset vedimma shettikdom beilato liriyyatah velo yada sheasur lifrosh miyyad. shennimtzeu lo shete haalamot bishte habbeilot. aval im lo yada sheasur livol bishat havveset velo yada sheasur lifrosh min hattuma miyyad af al pi shepperash miyyad vehu mitkashshe eno chayyav ella chattat achat. mippene shekkenisato vitziato shehen kishte beilot bishgaga achat hen uvehelem achat asa hakkol. vehu haddin bishar haarayot sheim shagag uva al haerva al daat shehi mutteret venoda lo shehi erva vehu betoch hattashmish. lo yifrosh miyyad sheyyetziato hanaa lo keviato. veim lo yada sheasur lifrosh miyyad uferash vehu mitkashshe eno chayyav ella chattat achat. shehakkol shegaga achat hi:

Din shiggat hammaachalot kedin shiggat habbeilot. lefichach im achal achilot harebe mishshem echad behelem achat. af al pi sheyyesh benehen yamim rabbim eno chayyav ella chattat achat. ketzad. achal chelev hayyom veachal chelev lemachar vechelev lemachar behelem achat. af al pi shehen bishlosha tamchuyin eno chayyav ella achat. aval im achal kezayit chelev venoda lo vechazar veachal kezayit chelev venoda lo. chayyav al kol achila vaachila shehayediot mechallekot hashshegagot. achal kachatzi zayit chelev vechazar veachal kachatzi zayit chelev behelem achat af al pi shehen sheni tamchuyin veaf al pi shehifsik benehen hare ellu mitztarfin umevi chattat. sheen hattamchuyin mechallekin. vehu shello yishhe benehen yoter mikkede achilat shalosh betzim kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot. shekkeshem shemmitztaref hashshiur lemezid lemalkot kach mitztaref hashshiur leshogeg lekarban:
Achal notar mechamishsha zevachim kezayit mikkol zevach behelem achat. af al pi sheachalan bachamishsha tamchuyin eno chayyav ella chattat achat shekkullan shem echad hen vehattamchuyin enan mechallekin. vegufe hazzevachim enan mechallekin. sheechad haochel basar mizzevachim rabbim o mizzevach echad. vechen hashshochet chamishsha zevachim bachutz behelem achat. eno chayyav ella chattat achat. ha lema ze dome lemishtachave lechamesh tzurot behelem achat:
Hikkiz dam livhemto vekibbelo bishne kosot ushetaan behelem achat eno mevi ella chattat achat:
Haochel maachalot harebe mishshemot harebe behelem achat chayyav al kol shem veshem. ketzad. kegon sheachal chelev vedam venotar ufiggul kezayit mikkol echad veechad behelem achat mevi arba chattaot. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. vechen haochel kezayit echad shennitkabbetzu bo shemot harebe behelem achat. im nitkabbetzu beissur mosif o beissur kolel o beissur bat achat chayyav al kol shem veshem. lefichach hattame sheachal kezayit chelev venotar beyom hakkippurim. mevi arba chattaot veasham. chattat achat mishshum tame sheachal kodesh. veachat mishshum ochel chelev. veachat mishshum ochel notar. veachat mishshum yom hakkippurim. vehu sheyyitztaref ochel acher im kezayit ze ad sheyyashlimo lichchotevet. umevi asham vadday limila shehare nehena min hahekdesh bishgaga:
Haochel veshote beyom hakkippurim behelem achat eno chayyav ella chattat achat. achila ushetiyya achat hi:
Haose melacha beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat chayyav shete chattaot mippene shehen shene issurin habbain keechad:
Achal kachatzi zayit chelev vechachatzi zayit dam behelem achat eno chayyav karban. keshem sheen haissurin mitztarfin lammalkot kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot kach en mitztarfin lekarban:
Achal kachatzi zayit venoda lo vechazar veshachach veachal kachatzi zayit acher behelem sheni patur. shehare noda lo bentayim veyesh yedia lachatzi shiur. vechen im katav ot achat [beshabbat] bishgaga venoda lo vechazar veshachach vechatav ot sheniyya semucha lah behelem sheni patur mikkarban chattat. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen im hotzi shete ammot beshogeg ushete ammot bemezid ushete ammot beshogeg. im bizrika chayyav. lo mippene sheen yedia lachatzi shiur ella mippene sheen beyado lehachezirah. lefichach lo hoila lo hayedia shebbentayim. veim behaavara patur sheyyesh yedia lachatzi shiur kemo shebbearnu:
Haochel kezayit chelev uchezayit chelev behelem achat venoda lo al harishon vechazar venoda lo al hashsheni mevi shete chattaot shehayediot mechallekot veaf al pi sheadayin lo hifrish hakkarban. aval im noda lo al shenehen keachat mevi chattat achat. vechen yerae li shehu haddin bivilot:
Achal kezayit umechetza behelem achat venoda lo al kezayit vechazar veachal chatzi zayit behealmo shel sheni. eno chayyav ella chattat achat. sheen chatzi zayit haacharon mitztaref larishon af al pi shehu behealmo shehare noda lo al miktzat haalama rishona:
Achal shene zete chelev behelem achat venoda lo al achat mehen vechazar veachal kezayit acher behealmo shel sheni vehevi chattat al harishon. rishon vesheni mitkapperin aval shelishi lo nitkapper. ella kesheyyivvada lo alav yavi chattat acheret. hevi chattat al hashshelishi. shelishi vesheni mitkapperin sheshshenehem behelem achat. verishon lo nitkapper bechattat zo. hevi chattat al haemtzai. shelashtan mitkapperin. mippene sheharishon vehashshelishi behealmo shel emtzai. uchesheyyivvada lo al harishon veal hashshelishi en tzarich lehavi chattat acheret:
Mi sheachal chaticha mishshete chatichot venistappek lo im achal chelev o shumman veachal chaticha acheret mishshete chatichot venistappek lo im achal chelev o shumman veachar kach noda lo bevadday shechelev achal barishona uvashsheniyya. eno chayyav ella chattat achat. sheyyediat safek shehayta lo bentayim af al pi shemmechalleket laashamot enah mechalleket lechattaot:

Hammishtachav laavoda zara venissech vekitter vezibbeach behelem achat chayyav arba chattaot. vechen im pier atzmo lifor vezarak even lemarkulis behelem achat. chayyav shetayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze yehe chayyav al kol avoda vaavoda. bamme devarim amurim beshehezid baavoda zara veshagag baavodot ellu. aval im hezid baavodot ellu veshagag baavoda zara eno chayyav ella chattat achat. ketzad. yada shezzo avoda zara vesheasur leavdah aval lo yada shehahishtachavaya vehannissuch avera vehishtachava venissech chayyav shetayim. yada sheellu avodot hen veasur laavod bahen leel acher velo yada shezzo avoda zara lefi shello hayta shel kesef vezahav veala al dato sheen keruyin avoda zara ella shel kesef vezahav vaavadah bechol haavodot eno chayyav ella chattat achat:
Kelal gadol amru beshabbat kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat veshachach shennitztauu yisrael al hashshabbat. o shennishba vehu katan leven haakkum o nitgayyer katan vehu ben haakkum. af al pi sheasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe eno chayyav ella chattat achat shehakkol shegaga achat hi. vechen chayyav chattat achat al kol chelev sheachal vechattat achat al dam sheachal. vechen kol kayyotze baze baavodot ellu. vechol hayyodea ikkar shabbat aval shachach shehayyom shabbat vedimma shehu chol af al pi sheasa bo melachot harebe chayyav chattat achat al hayyom kullo vechen chattat al kol shabbat veshabbat sheshshagag bo:
Vechol hayyodea shehayyom shabbat veshagag bimlachot velo yada shemmelachot ellu asurot o sheyyada shehen asurot velo yada shechayyavin alehen karet veasa melachot harebe. chayyav chattat al kol av melacha umelacha. afillu asa haarbaim chaser achat behelem achat mevi sheloshim vetesha chattaot:
Shachach shehayyom shabbat veshagag af bimlachot velo yada shemmelachot ellu asurot eno chayyav ella chattat achat:
Haose av vetoldotav behelem achat eno chayyav ella chattat achat. veen tzarich lomar haose toladot harebe shel av echad sheeno chayyav ella chattat achat:
Asa tolada shel av ze vetolada shel av ze behelem achat. yerae li shehu chayyav shete chattaot:
Asa melachot harebe meen melacha achat. kegon shezzara vehivrich vehirkiv behelem achat eno chayyav ella chattat achat. uchevar nitbaer behilchot shabbat haavot vehattoladot vehammelachot shehen meen avot:
Asa melachot harebe meen melacha achat beshabbatot harebe ben bizdon shabbota veshiggat melachot ben beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot chayyav al kol melacha umelacha. ketzad. yada shehayyom shabbat vezara bo mippene shello yada shehazzeria melacha. vechen beshabbat sheniyya yada shehu shabbat venata bah mippene shello yada shehannetia asura mishshum melacha. vechen beshabbat shelishit hivrich mippene shello yada shehahavracha melacha. chayyav al kol achat veachat af al pi shehi meen melacha achat. mippene shehashshabbatot kegufin muchlakin:
Shagag shehayyom shabbat vezara bo vehu yodea shehazzeria melacha. vechen beshabbat sheniyya shachach shehu shabbat venata bo vehu yodea shehannetia melacha. vechen bashshelishit shachach shehu shabbat vehivrich af al pi sheyyodea shehahavracha melacha. hare ze chayyav al kol achat veachat. shehayyamim shebben shabbat leshabbat hare hen kidia achat lechallek:
Mi shekkatzar vetachan kigrogeret beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot sheeno chayyav ella chattat achat. vechazar vekatzar vetachan kigrogeret bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot shehu chayyav al kol melacha umelacha. venoda lo al ketzira shel shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot. ketzira goreret ketzira utechina goreret techina ucheillu asa arbatan beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot sheeno chayyav ella chattat achat. vechevan shehikriv chattat zo nitkapper lo al hakkol. uchesheyyedaem achar ken eno tzarich lehavi chattat acheret. aval im noda lo techilla al ketzirah shel zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot vehikriv chattat. nitkapper lo al zo hakketzira shennoda lo aleha veal hakketzira vehattechina shel shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot. mippene sheshshenehen kimlacha achat venigrera ketzira utechina im hakketzira vetishshaer hattechina shel zedon shabbat ad sheyyivvada lo aleha veyavi chattat sheniyya. katzar kachatzi gerogeret beshiggat shabbat uzedon melachot vechazar vekatzar kachatzi gerogeret bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot hare ellu mitztarfin. ketzirah goreret ketzira. vechen kol kayyotze baze bishar melachot:
Hammitkavven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar af al pi shennitkavven lachaticha hoil velo asa machshavto patur min hachattat shezze kemitassek velo asra tora ella melechet machashevet kemo shebbearnu kamma peamim:
Hachote gechalim beshabbat shehu mechabbe et haelyonot umadlik et hattachtonot im nitkavven lechabbot ulehavir chayyav shetayim. chata gechalim lehitchammem mehem vehuvaru mealehen chayyav shetayim mippene shemmelacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha kemo shebbearnu behilchot shabbat. ucheshem shechayyavin al zedonah karet kach chayyav al shiggatah karban chattat:

Kol chet shechayyavin al shiggato chattat kevua chayyavin al lo hoda shello asham taluy. umahu lo hoda. im nistappek lo im shagag bedavar ze o lo shagag hare ze metzuvve lehakeriv asham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 17)</small> "velo yada veashem venasa avono" <small>(Vayikra 5 18)</small> "vehevi ayil tamim min hatztzon beerkecha leasham" vezehu hannikra asham taluy mippene shehu mechapper al hassafek vetole lo ad sheyyivvada lo bevadday shechata bishgaga veyakriv chattato:
Eno chayyav beasham taluy ad sheyyihye sham issur kavua. ketzad. achal chelev vesafek im haya kezayit o pachot mikkezayit. o shehayta lefanav chatichat chelev vachatichat shumman veachal achat mehen veen yadua e ze mehen achal. ishto vaachoto immo babbayit baal achat mehen veen yodea e zo mehen baal. shabbat vechol veasa melachot beechad mehem veen yadua bee ze yom asa. o sheasa melacha beshabbat velo yada meen e zo melacha asa. hare ze mevi asham taluy. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im hayta lefanav chaticha achat safek shehi chelev safek shehi shumman vaachalah patur shehare en kan issur kavua. vechol haochel chelev hakkevi patur measham taluy shehare en kan issur kavua. vechen habba al ishsha shehi sefek nidda o sefek erva shel keruv basar patur measham taluy. lefichach haishsha shennimtza dam al ed shellah leachar zeman vehannose yevimto betoch shelosha chodashim veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon hare ellu peturin min hakkarban. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. shehare en sham issur kavua:
Haochel chaticha veed echad omer lo ze sheachalta chelev haya veed echad omer lo achalta chelev. ishsha omeret achal veishsha omeret lo achal. hoil venikba haissur vehu eno yodea im chata o lo chata hare ze mevi asham taluy. vechen kol habba al eshet ish sheed echad omer met balah veed echad omer lo met. chayyav beasham taluy. vehu haddin lisfek megoreshet shehare nikba haissur. aval sefek mekuddeshet lo nikba haissur:
Mi shehayu lefanav shete chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman. veachal achat mehen uva akkum o kelev veachal et hashsheniyya. o sheachal akkum o kelev et harishona uva yisrael veachal hashsheniyya. o sheachal rishona bezadon usheniyya bishgaga. o sheachal rishona bishgaga usheniyya bezadon. hare ze chayyav beasham taluy hoil vehaya shamma issur kavua. achal shetehen bezadon patur mikkarban. achal shetehen bishgaga mevi chattat. achal et harishona bishgaga uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya bishgaga shenehen chayyavin beasham taluy. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Chelev venotar lefanav. achal achat mehen veen yadua e zo mehen achal. ishto nidda vaachoto immo babbayit veshagag beachat mehen veen yadua e zo mehen baal. shabbat veyom hakkippurim veasa melacha ben hashshemashot shebbenehen. hare ze patur mikkarban veeno mevi chattat shehare eno yodea atzmo shel chet kemo shebbearnu. veeno mevi asham taluy shehare yodea bevadday shechata:
Kol davar shechayyavin al vaddao chattat kevua achat chayyavin al lo hoda shello asham taluy echad. vechol davar shechayyavin al vaddao chattaot harebe chayyavin al lo hoda shello ashamot teluyin harebe keminyan hachattaot. ketzad. keshem sheim achal chelev vedam venotar ufiggul behelem achat chayyav arba chattaot. kach im nistappek lo im achalan o lo achal ella chatichot shel hetter shehayu immahem mevi arbaa ashamot teluyin. vechen im nistappek lo im haishsha shebba aleha ishto. o pelonit haerva shehayta immah shechayyav aleha shemone chattaot. hare ze mevi shemona ashamot teluyin:
Haochel chaticha mishshete chatichot venistappek lo im shel chelev achal o shel shumman achal veachar shennolad lo hassafek achal chaticha mishshete chatichot acherot venistappek lo im shel chelev achal o shel shumman. hare ze mevi shete ashamot teluyin:
Keshem sheyyediat vadday bentayim mechalleket lechattaot kach yediat safek bentayim mechalleket laashamot. lefichach im achal chamishsha zete chelev behelem achat. venoda lo yediat safek al achat mehem vechazar venoda lo yediat safek acheret al hashsheni. vechen al kol achat veachat. chayyav asham taluy al kol achat veachat:
Chaticha shel shumman vachaticha shel chelev. achal achat mehen veen yadua e zo hi vehevi asham taluy. vechazar veachal et hashsheniyya mevi chattat. vechen im achal acher et hashsheniyya mevi haacher asham taluy kemo shebbearnu:
Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev notar. achal et achat mehen veen yadua e zo hi. mevi chattat al hachelev veasham taluy mishshum notar. achal et hashsheniyya behelem sheni mevi shalosh chattaot. veim haya bah sheve peruta mevi asham vadday mishshum meila. achal echad et achat mishshetehen. uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya. ze mevi chattat veasham taluy veze mevi chattat veasham taluy. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Al chamesh averot mevi karban asham vehu hannikra asham vadday shehare eno ba mishshum safek. veellu hen. al shifcha charufa veal haggezel veal hammeila veal tumat nazir veal hatztzaraat kesheyyithar mimmenna. al shifcha charufa ketzad. habba al shifcha charufa ben bezadon ben bishgaga mevi asham. vehu shettihye gedola umezida uvirtzonah vetihye beula kedarkah uvigmar bia kede shettilke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "bikkoret tihye" <small>(Vayikra 19 21)</small> "vehevi et ashamo" hi loka vehu mevi karban:
Umippi hashshemua lamdu shebbizman shehi chayyevet malkot hu chayyav bekarban uvizman shehi petura min hammalkot hu patur min hakkarban:
Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al shifcha charufa. hi loka vehu mevi karban. veyerae li sheeno mevi ad sheyyagdil veyihye ben daat:
Kevar bearnu behilchot biot asurot ma hi hashshifcha hacharufa haamura battora. vesheenan chayyavin ad sheyyivol kedarkah veyigmor. lefichach im amru lo shenayim baalta shifcha charufa vehu omer lo baalti neeman veeno mevi karban al pihen. shehare hu yodea im gamar biato o lo gamar veze sheamar lo baalti kelomar lo gamarti:
Habba al hashshifcha biot harebe eno chayyav ella asham echad. ketzad. habba al hashshifcha biot harebe bezadon o shebba aleha bishgaga venoda lo vechazar uva aleha bishgaga venoda lo. afillu mea peamim bemea haalamot. makriv asham echad umitkapper lo al hakkol al hazzedonot shebbah veal hashshegagot. bamme devarim amurim beshifcha achat. aval habba al shefachot harebe afillu behelem achat chayyav asham al kol shifcha veshifcha:
Baal shifcha vehifrish ashamo vechazar uvealah achar shehifrish ashamo chayyav al kol achat veachat shehahafrasha mechalleket venimtza kemi shehikriv veachar kach baal. vechen im baal chamesh beilot behelem achat beshifcha achat venoda lo al achat mehen vehifrish ashamo veachar kach noda al hashsheniyya mafrish asham acher af al pi shebbehelem achat hayu kullan hoil velo noda lo ella achar shehifrish nimtza kevoel achar shehifrish. sheddin hashshogeg vehammezid beshifcha echad hu:
